a: Bishne reavon.
Tanya, rabbi omer: "veish ba mibbaal shalisha vayyave leish haelohim lechem bikkurim esrim lechem seorim vegomer".

Veen lecha kalla bechol eretz yisrael levashshel peroteha yoter mibbaal shalisha, veaf al pi chen lo bikkera ella min echad. shemma tomar: chittim? talmud lomar: "seorim". shemma tomar: lifne haomer? talmud lomar: "ten laam veyochelu". achar haomer haya.
Emor meatta: reuya hayta otah shana shettitabber, umippene ma lo ibberah elisha? sheshshenat batztzoret hayta, vehayu hakkol ratzin levet haggoranot.

Tanu rabbanan: en meabberin et hashshana lifne rosh hashshana, veim ibberuha – enah meubberet. aval mippene haddechak meabberin otah achar rosh hashshana miyyad, veaf al pi ken en meabberin ella adar.
Ini? veha shelachu leh lerava: zug ba merakkat, utefaso nesher, uveyado devarim hannaasim beluz. umay nihu? techelet. bizchut harachamim uvizchutam yatzu beshalom.

Vaamuse yereche nachshon bikkeshu likboa netziv echad, velo hinnichan adomi hallaz. aval baale asuppot neesfu vekavu lo netziv echad beyerach shemmet bo aharon hakkohen. chashshove – mechashshevi, galloye – la megallu.

May mashma dehay "netziv" lishshana deyarcha hu? dichtiv: "velishlomo shenem asar nitztzavim al kol yisrael vechilkelu et hammelech veet anashav chodesh bashshana". vehachtiv: "unetziv echad [asher] baaretz"? rav yehuda verav nachman, chad amar: echad memunne al kullam, vechad amar: keneged chodesh haibbur.

Tanu rabbanan: en meabberin et hashshana lo mishshana lachavertah, velo shalosh shanim zo achar zo. amar rabbi shimon: maase berabbi akiva shehaya chavush bevet haasurim, veibber shalosh shanim zo achar zo. amru lo: mishsham reaya? bet din yashvu vekavu achat achat bizmannah.
Tanu rabbanan: en meabberin et hashshana lo bishviit velo bemotzae sheviit. ematay regilin leabber? erev sheviit. shel bet rabban gamliel hayu meabberin bemotzae sheviit.
Uviflugeta dehane tannae, detanya: en meviin yarak mechutza laaretz, verabbotenu hittiru. may benayyhu? amar rabbi yirmeya: choshshin legushehen ikka benayyhu.
Tanu rabbanan: en meabberin et hashshana mippene hattumea.

Rabbi yehuda omer: meabberin. amar rabbi yehuda: maase bechizkiyya melech yehuda sheibber et hashshana mippene hattumea, uvikkesh rachamim al atzmo, dichtiv: "ki marbit haam rabbat meefrayim umenashshe yissashchar uzevulun lo hitteharu
b: Ki achlu et happesach belo chakkatuv ki hitpallel chizkiyyahu alehem lemor Adonai hattov yechapper bead".

Rabbi shimon omer: im mippene hattumea ibberuha, meubberet. ella mippene ma bikkesh rachamim al atzmo? sheen meabberin ella adar, vehu ibber nisan benisan. rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: mippene shehissi et yisrael laasot pesach sheni.
Amar mar: rabbi yehuda omer: meabberin. alma, it leh lerabbi yehuda: tumea dechuya hi betzibbur.
Veha tanya: tzitz, ben sheyyeshno al mitzcho uven sheeno al mitzcho – meratztze, divre rabbi shimon. rabbi yehuda omer: odo al mitzcho – meratztze, en odo al mitzcho – eno meratztze.
Amar lo rabbi shimon: kohen gadol beyom hakkippurim yochiach, sheeno al mitzcho umeratztze. amar lo rabbi yehuda: hannach leyom hakkippurim, shettumea huttera betzibbur.

Velitamaych, tikshe lach hi gufa: rabbi yehuda omer meabberin, veamar rabbi yehuda: maase bechizkiyya melech yehuda sheibber et hashshana mippene hattumea, uvikkesh rachamim al atzmo? ella, chassore mechassera vehachi katane: en meabberin et hashshana mippene hattumea, veim ibberuha – meubberet. rabbi yehuda omer: enah meubberet. veamar rabbi yehuda vechulei.

I hachi, rabbi shimon omer: im mippene hattumea ibberuha – meubberet. hayeynu tanna kamma? amar rava: lechattechilla ikka benayyhu. tanya name hachi: en meabberin et hashshana mippene hattumea lechattechilla. rabbi shimon omer: meabberin. ella mippene ma bikkesh rachamim al atzmo? sheen meabberin ella adar, vehu ibber nisan benisan.

Amar mar: sheen meabberin ella adar, vehu ibber nisan benisan. velet leh lechizkiyya "hachodesh hazze lachem" – ze nisan, veen acher nisan! tea bedishmuel, deamar shemuel: en meabberin et hashshana beyom sheloshim shel adar, hoil verauy lekovo nisan.
Veihu savar: "hoil verauy" la amrinan. tanya name hachi: en meabberin et hashshana beyom sheloshim shel adar, hoil verauy lekovo nisan.

Rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: mippene shehissi et yisrael laasot pesach sheni. hechi dame? amar rav ashe: kegon shehayu yisrael mechetza temeim, mechetza tehorim, venashim mashlimot lattehorim veodfot alehem.
Meikkara sevar: nashim barishon chova, dehavu miutan temeim, umiutan middechu lefesach sheni. ulevassof sevar: nashim barishon reshut, dehavu lehu temeim rubba, verubba la middechu lefesach sheni.

Gufa, amar shemuel: en meabberin et hashshana beyom sheloshim shel adar, hoil verauy lekovo nisan. ibberuha, may? amar ulla: en mekaddeshin et hachodesh. kiddeshu, may? amar rava: batel haibbur. rav nachman amar: meubbar umekuddash.

Amar leh rava lerav nachman: mikkede mippurayya lefischa telatin yomin havo, umippurayya darshinan behilchot happesach, detanya: shoalin behilchot happesach kodem lefesach sheloshim yom. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: shete shabbatot. vechi mate resh yarcha merachakin leh? ate lezalzole bechametz!
Amar leh: midda yadyi deshatta meabbarta bechushebana talya milleta. amri: chushebana hu dela selek lehu lerabbanan ad hasheta.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: en meabberin et hashshana ella im ken hayta tekufa chasera rubbo shel chodesh. vechamma rubbo shel chodesh? shishsha asar yom; divre rabbi yehuda.

a: Rabbi yose omer: echad veesrim yom. ushenehem mikra echad darshu: "chag haasif tekufat hashshana". mar savar: kulleh chag baenan bitkufa chadasha, umar savar: miktzat chag baenan bitkufa chadasha.
May ka savri? i kasavri yom tekufa gomer, belav hachi name, la leman deamar kulleh chag ikka, vela leman deamar miktzat chag ikka. ella kasavri yom tekufa matchil.
Metivi: yom tekufa gomer, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: yom tekufa matchil.

Veod, tanya: en meabberin et hashshana ella im ken hayta tekufa chasera rubbo shel chodesh. vechamma rubbo shel chodesh? shishsha asar yom. rabbi yehuda omer: shete yadot bachodesh. vechamma shete yadot bachodesh? esrim yom.

Rabbi yose omer: mechashshevin shishsha asar lifne happesach, meabberin; shishsha asar lifne hachag, en meabberin. rabbi shimon omer: af shishsha asar lifne hachag meabberin. acherim omrim: miuto, vechamma miuto? arbaa asar yom. kashya!
Amar mar: rabbi yehuda omer: shete yadot bachodesh, esrim yom. rabbi yose omer: mechashshevin shishsha asar yom lifne happesach, meabberin. hayeynu rabbi yehuda!
Yom tekufa gomer, veyom tekufa matchil – ikka benayyhu.
Amar mar: shishsha asar lifne hachag en meabberin. ella lerabbi yose, shishsha asar lifne hachag hu dela, ha shivsar vetamnesar meabberin?
Vehaamar: shishsha asar lifne happesach – in, betzir – la!
La, idi veidi en meabberin, veayyeyde ditna resha "shishsha asar lifne happesach", tena name "shishsha asar lifne hachag".
Rabbi shimon omer: af shishsha asar lifne hachag meabberin. hayeynu tanna kamma?
b: Ikka benayyhu yom tekufa matchil veyom tekufa gomer. vela mesayyeymi.

Acherim omrim: miuto, vechamma miuto? arbaa asar yom. may kasavri? i kasavri yom tekufa gomer, vechulleh chag baenan – haikka! amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak: acherim bitkufat nisan kayymi, dichtiv: "shamor et chodesh haaviv" – shemor aviv shel tekufa sheyyehe bechodesh nisan.
Veliabbereh laadar? amar rav acha bar yaakov: tanna millemala lematta kachashev, vehachi kaamar: ad miuto meabberin. vechamma miuto? arbaa asar yom.
Ravina amar: leolam acherim betishri kayymi, vekasavri acherim kulleh chag baenan, veyom tov rishon. yom tov rishon? "chag haasif" ketiv! chag habba bizman asifa.
Semichat zekenim. tanu rabbanan: "vesamchu zikne" – yachol zikne hashshuk? talmud lomar "eda".

I "eda" – yachol ketanne eda? talmud lomar "haeda" – meyuchadin shebbaeda. vechamma hen? "vesamchu" – shenayim, "zikne" – shenayim, veen bet din shakul mosifin alehem od echad, hare kan chamishsha. divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer: "zikne" – shenayim, veen bet din shakul mosifin alehen od echad, hare kan shelosha.
Verabbi shimon, hachtiv "vesamchu"? hahu mibbee leh legufeh. verabbi yehuda? legufeh la tzerich, deim ken dela ate "vesamchu" lidrasha, lichtov "zikne haeda yedehem al rosh happar".
Verabbi shimon, i ketiv hachi, hava amena: may "al"? besamuch. verabbi yehuda gamar "rosh" "rosh" meola. verabbi shimon la gamar "rosh" "rosh" meola.
Tana: semicha usemichat zekenim bishlosha. may semicha umay semichat zekenim? amar rabbi yochanan: mismach save.

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: mismach save bishlosha menalan? illema middichtiv "vayyismoch et yadav alav", i hachi tisge bechad! vechi tema moshe bimkom shivim vechad kae, i hachi live shivim vechad! kashya.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: bida mammash samchin leh? amar leh: samchin leh bishma, karu leh "rabbi", veyahavi leh reshuta lemedan dine kenasot.
Vechad la samech? veha amar rav yehuda amar rav: beram, zachur oto haish lattov, verabbi yehuda ben bava shemo, sheilmale hu nishtachchu dine kenasot miyyisrael. nishtachchu? nigrosinhu! ella

a: Batlu dine kenasot miyyisrael, sheppaam achat gazra malchut harshaa shemad al yisrael – shekkol hassomech yehareg, vechol hannismach yehareg, veir shessomchin bah techarev, utechumin shessomchin bahen yeakru.

Ma asa yehuda ben bava? halach veyashav lo ben shene harim gedolim, uven shete ayayrot gedolot, uven shene techume shabbat, ben usha lishfaram, vesamach sham chamishsha zekenim. veellu hen: rabbi meir, verabbi yehuda, verabbi shimon, verabbi yose, verabbi elazar ben shammua. rav avya mosif: af rabbi nechemya.

Kevan shehikkiru oyvehem bahen, amar lahen: banayy, rutzu! amru lo: rabbi, ma tehe alecha? amar lahen: hareni mutal lifnehem keeven sheen lah hofchim. amru: lo zazu mishsham ad shennaatzu bo shelosh meot lunechiot shel barzel vaasauhu kichvara.

Rabbi yehuda ben bava acharine havo bahadeh, vehay dela chashev lehu – mishshum kevodo derabbi yehuda ben bava. verabbi meir, rabbi yehuda ben bava samcheh? veha amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kol haomer rabbi meir lo semacho rabbi akiva eno ella toe! samcheh rabbi akiva velo kayblu, semacheha rabbi yehuda ben bava vekayblu.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: en semicha bechutza laaretz. may "en semicha"? illema dela dayyni dine kenasot kelal bechutza laaretz, veha tenan: sanhedrin noheget ben baaretz uven bechutza laaretz! ella, dela samchinan bechutza laaretz.
Peshita: somchin bechutza laaretz venismachin baaretz, ha amrinan dela. ella, somchin baaretz venismachin bechutza laaretz – may?

Ta shema: derabbi yochanan hava mitztaer aleh derav shemen bar abba, dela hava gabbayyhu delismecheh. rabbi shimon ben zerud vechad deimmeh, umannu? rabbi yonatan ben achmay. veamri la: rabbi yonatan ben achmay vechad deimmeh, umannu? rabbi shimon ben zerud. chad dahava gabbayyhu – samchuhv, vechad dela hava gabbayyhu – la samchuhv.
Rabbi chanina verabbi hoshaya hava ka mishtekid rabbi yochanan lemismechinhu. la hava mistayyeya milleta, hava ka mitztaar tuva. amaru leh: la nitztaar mar, daanan middevet eli kaatenan.

Deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachman amar rabbi yonatan: minnayin sheen nismachin levet eli? shenneemar: "lo yihye zaken bevetcha kol hayyamim". may zaken? illema zaken mammash, vehachtiv: "kol marbit betcha yamutu anashim"! ella semicha.

Rabbi zera hava mittammar millemismecheh, deamar rabbi elazar: leolam heve kavel vekayyaym. kevan deshama leha deamar rabbi elazar, en adam ole ligdulla ella im ken mochalin lo al kol avonotav, amtzi nafsheh.

Ki samchu lerabbi zera, sharu leh hachi: "lo kachal velo sarak velo pirkus, veyaalat chen". ki samchu lerabbi amme ulerabbi assi, sharu lehu hachi: "kol min den, kol min den, semuchu lana. la tismechu lana la missarmitin vela missarmisin". veamri la: "la mechamisin vela mitturemisin".
Rabbi avahu, ki hava ate mimmetivta leve kesar, nafki matronyata deve kesar umesharyayn leh: "rabba deammeh, medabberana deummeteh, butzina dinhora, berich metyaych lishlam".

Arifat egla bishlosha. tanu rabbanan: "veyatzu zekenecha veshoftecha". "zekenecha" – shenayim, "shoftecha" – shenayim, veen bet din shakul mosifin alehen od echad, hare kan chamishsha. divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer: "zekenecha" – shenayim, veen bet din shakul mosifin alehem od echad, hare kan shelosha.
Verabbi shimon, hay "shoftecha" may aved leh? hahu mibbee leh limyuchadin shebbeshoftecha. verabbi yehuda? mizzikne" "zekenecha" nafka.

Verabbi shimon: i mizzikne" hava amena zikne hashshuk, ketav rachamana "zekenecha". vei ketiv "zekenecha" – hava amena sanhedri ketanna, ketav rachamana "veshoftecha" – mimmeyuchadin shebbeshoftecha. verabbi yehuda gamar "zikne" "zikne" mivsamchu zikne haeda et yedehem" – ma lehallan meyuchadin shebbaeda, af kan meyuchadin shebbizkenecha.
I yalef – lelaf kulla mehatam! "zekenecha" "veshoftecha" lema li? ella, vav "veshoftecha" leminyayna. verabbi shimon – vav la daresh.
Ella meatta, "veyatzu" – shenayim, "umaddu" – shenayim, lerabbi yehuda hare tisha, lerabbi shimon shiva? hahu mibbee leh lechidtanya: "veyatzu" – hen velo sheluchan, "umaddu" – sheafillu nimtza
b: Baalil lair, tzarich laasok bimdida.

Matnitin dela ki hay tanna, detanya: rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: "veyatzu zekenecha veshoftecha", "zekenecha" – zo sanhedrin, "veshoftecha" – ze melech vechohen gadol. melech – dichtiv: "melech bammishpat yaamid aretz". kohen gadol – dichtiv: "uvata el hakkohanim haleviyyim veel hashshofet".

Ibbaya lehu: rabbi eliezer ben yaakov bachada pelig o betarte pelig? bemelech vechohen gadol pelig, aval besanhedre – i kerabbi yehuda i kerabbi shimon? o dilma besanhedre name pelig, deamar: kulla sanhedri baenan?
Amar rav yosef: ta shema, metzaan abbet pagge vehimra alehen, yachol tehe hameraato hameraa? talmud lomar: "vekamta vealita el hammakom", melammed shehammakom gorem.

Dinfuk kamma? illema miktzatan, dilma hanach deikka gavvay kayymi kevavteh? ella peshita dinfuk kullehu. lemay? ilema lidvar harshut, mi matzu nafki? vehachtiv: "shorrech aggan hassahar al yechsar hammazeg"! ella peshita lidvar mitzva.

Hechi dame? lav limdidat egla, verabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi, deamar: kulle sanhedre baenan? amar leh abbaye: la, kegon sheyyatzu lehosif al hair veal haazarot, keditnan: en mosifin al hair veal haazarot ella bevet din shel shivim veechad.

Tanya kevavteh derav yosef: metzaan abbet page vehimra alehen, kegon sheyyatzu limdidat egla ulehosif al hair veal haazarot, yachol shettehe hameraato hameraa? talmud lomar: "vekamta vealita el hammakom", melammed shehammakom gorem.

Neta revai umaaser sheni sheen damav yeduin, bishlosha. tanu rabbanan: ezehu maaser sheni sheen damav yeduin? perot shehirkivu, veyayin shehikris, umaot shehechlidu. tanu rabbanan: maaser sheni sheen damav yeduin, podin oto bishlosha lakochot, aval lo bishlosha sheen lakochot. afillu goy echad mehen, afillu echad mehem bealim.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: shelosha umetilin letoch kis echad, mahu? ta shema: ish ushete nashav podin maaser sheni sheen damav yeduin. dilma kegon rav pappa uvat abba suraa.
Hahekdeshot bishlosha. matnitin dela ki hay tanna, detanya: rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, afillu tzinnora shel hekdesh tzericha asara bene adam lifdotah.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: bishlama lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov, deamar kishmuel, deamar shemuel: asara kohanim ketuvin bapparasha, ella lerabbanan – shelosha mena lehu?
Vechi tema dichtiv behu shelosha, karkaot dichtiv behu arbaa tisge bearbaa? vechi tema: hachi name, allema tenan: hakkarkaot tisha vechohen?
Ella may, demashlemi behu asara? hekdeshot, demashlemi behu shitta, livo shitta! kashya.
Haarachin kulei. may arachin hammittaltelin? amar rav giddel amar rav: beomer "erech keli ze alay". deamar rav giddel amar rav:

a: Haomer: "erech keli ze alay" – noten damav. may tama? adam yodea sheen erech lichli, vegamar veamar leshum damim. mishshum hachi noten damav. hay "arachin hammittaltelin"? "arachin shel mittaltelin" mibbaya leh! teni: arachin shel mittaltelin.
Rav chisda amar avimi: bematpis mittaltelin laarachin. hay "arachin hammittaltelin"? "mittaltelin shel arachin" mibbee leh! teni: mittaltelin shel arachin.

Rabbi avahu amar: beomer "erki alay", ba kohen ligbot mimmennu mittaltelin – bishlosha, karkaot – baasara. amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: bishlama leappoke mehekdesh baenan shelosha, ella leayyole lehekdesh shelosha lema li?
Amar leh: sevara hu, ma li ayyole, ma li appoke? appoke may tama: dilma tae. ayyole name dilma tae.
Rabbi yehuda omer kulei. amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: bishlama lerabbi yehuda, hayeynu dichtiv "kohen". ella lerabbanan, "kohen" lema lehu? kashya.

Hakkarkaot tisha vechohen. menahane mille? amar shemuel: asara kohanim ketuvin bapparasha, chad legufeh, hanach have miut achar miut, veen miut achar miut ella lerabbot, daafillu tisha yisrael veechad kohen.
Matkef la rav huna bereh derav natan: ema, chamishsha kohanim vachamishsha yisreelim? kashya!
Veadam keyotze bahen. adam mi kadosh? amar rabbi avahu: beomer "damay alay". detanya: haomer "damay alay" – shamin oto keeved hannimkar bashshuk. veeved ittakkash lekarkaot.
Bae rabbi avin: sear haomed leyiggazez, bechamma? kegazuz dame, uvishlosha? o kimchubbar dame, uvaasara?
Ta shema: hammakdish et avdo – en moalin bo. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: moalin bisaro. vekayyma lan devisaro haomed liggazez peligi. shema minna.

Nema: hane tannae kehane tannae. ditnan, rabbi meir omer: yesh devarim shehen kakkarka veenan kakkarka, veen chachamim modim lo. ketzad? eser gefanim teunot masarti lach, vehalla omer: enan ella chamesh – rabbi meir mechayyev, vachachamim omrim: kol hamechubbar lakkarka hare hu kakkarka.

Veamar rabbi yose bar chanina: baanavim haomdot libbatzer askinan. mar savar: kivtzurot damyayn, umar savar: lav kivtzurot damyayn. la, afillu tema rabbi meir. ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam, (kol) kamma deshavkat lehu michchash kachashi. aval searo, (kol) kamma deshavkat lehu ashboche mashbach.
Dine nefashot kulei. ka pasek vetane, la shena rovea zachar vela shena rovea nekeva. bishlama rovea nekeva, dichtiv: "veharagta et haishsha veet habbehema". ella rovea zachar, mena lan?

Dichtiv: "kol shochev im behema mot yumat". im eno inyan leshochev, tenehu inyan lenishkav. veappekeh rachamana bilshon shochev, leakkoshe nishkav leshochev: ma shochev – hu uvehemto beesrim ushelosha, af nishkav – hu uvehemto beesrim ushelosha.

Shor hanniskal beesrim ushelosha, shenneemar: "hashshor yissakel vegam bealav yumat". kemitat habbealim kach mitat hashshor. amar leh abbaye lerava: mimmay dehay "vegam bealav yumat" lichmitat bealim kach mitat hashshor hu daata?
b: Ema liktala hu daata! im ken, lichtov "vegam bealav", velishtok!
I ketav rachamana hachi, hava amena biskila. biskila salka datach? ketal ihu – besayif, mamono – biskila?
Vedilma hay dichtav rachamana "yumat" leakkole illaveh, leappoke missayif lechenek? hanicha leman deamar chenek chamur, ella leman deamar chenek kil, may ikka lememar?
La salka datach, dichtiv: "im kofer yushat alav". vei salka datach bar ketala hu, vehachtiv: "lo tikchu chofer lenefesh rotzeach"!

Adderabba, mishshum hi gufa: ketal ihu – la tisge leh bemamona ella biktala. ketal shoro – lifrok nafsheh bemamona. ella, amar chizkiyya vechen tana deve chizkiyya: amar kera "mot yumat hammakke rotzeach hu" – al retzichato atta horgo, vei atta horgo al retzichat shoro.
Ibbaya lehu: shor sinay bechamma? mi gamar shaa middorot, o la? ta shema, detane rame bar yechezkel: "im behema im ish lo yichye" – ma ish beesrim ushelosha, af behema beesrim ushelosha.

Haari vehazzeev kulei. amar resh lakish: vehu shehemitu, aval lo hemitu – la. alma kasavar: yesh lahen tarbut veyesh lahen bealim. rabbi yochanan amar: af al pi shello hemitu. alma kasavar: en lahem tarbut veen lahem bealim.

Tenan, rabbi eliezer omer: kol hakkodem lehorgan zacha. bishlama lerabbi yochanan, lemay zacha? zacha leoran. ella leresh lakish, lemay zacha? kevan shehemitu, shavvinhu rabbanan keman digmar dinayyhu, veissure hanaa ninhu.

May "zacha"? zacha lashshamayim. tanya kevavteh deresh lakish: echad shor shehemit veechad behema vechayya shehemitu – beesrim ushelosha. rabbi eliezer omer: shor shehemit – beesrim ushelosha, ushear behema vechayya shehemitu – kol hakkodem lehorgan zacha bahen lashshamayim.
Rabbi akiva omer vechulei. rabbi akiva hayeynu tanna kamma? ikka benayyhu nachash.

En danin kulei. hay shevet dachata bemay? ilema shevet shechillel et hashshabbat, emar defalleg rachamana ben yechidim limrubbin leinyan avodat kochavim, bishar mitzvot mi pelig? ella beshevet shehuddach.

Lememra divdina derabbim dayyninan leh? keman: la kerabbi yoshiyya vela kerabbi yonatan! detanya: ad kamma osin ir hanniddachat? measara vead mea, divre rabbi yoshiyya. rabbi yonatan omer: mimmea vead rubbo shel shevet.
Vaafillu rabbi yonatan la kaamar ella rubbo, aval kullo la. amar rav matna: hacha

a: Binsi shevet shechata askinan. mi la amar rav adda bar ahava: "kol haddavar haggadol yaviu elecha" – devarav shel gadol? hay name gadol hu.
Ulla amar rabbi elazar: bevain al iske nechalot, vechitchillatah shel eretz yisrael. ma techillatah shivim veechad, af kan – shivim veechad.
I, ma techillatah kalpi, urim vetummim, vechol yisrael – af kan kalpi, urim vetummim, vechol yisrael? ella mechavvavrta kidrav matna.
Ravina amar: leolam beshevet shehuddach, udeka kashya lach – bedina derabbim dayyninan leh? in, af al gav dekatlinan beyachid, be dina derabbim dayyninan leh.

Mi la amar rabbi chama berabbi yose amar rabbi oshaya: "vehotzeta et haish hahu o et haishsha hahiv vegomer"? ish veishsha atta motzi lisharecha, vei atta motzi kol hair kullah lisharecha. hacha name: ish veishsha atta motzi lisharecha, vei atta motzi kol hashshevet kullo lisharecha.
Lo et nevi hashsheker. menahane mille?
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: atya "hazada" "hazada" mizzaken mamre, ma lehallan beshivim veechad – af kan beshivim veechad.
Veha "hazada" ki ketiva, biktala hu dichtiva, uketala beesrin utelata hu! ella, amar resh lakish: gamar "davar" "davar" mehameraato.
Velehdar zaken mamre, veligmar "hazada" "hazada" minnevi hashsheker? "davar" "davar" gemir, "hazada" "hazada" la gemir.
Velo et kohen gadol. menahane mille? amar rav adda bar ahava: deamar kera "kol haddavar haggadol yaviu elecha", devarav shel gadol.
Metivi: "davar gadol" – davar kashe. atta omer davar kashe, o eno ella devarav shel gadol? keshehu omer "et haddavar hakkashe yeviun el moshe", hare davar kashe amur.

Hu deamar ki hay tanna, detanya: "davar gadol" – devarav shel gadol. atta omer devarav shel gadol, o eno ella davar hakkashe? keshehu omer "haddavar hakkashe", hare davar kashe amur. ha ma ani mekayyem "davar gadol"? devarav shel gadol.
Vehay tanna, tere kerae lema li? chad letzavvaa bealma, vechad laasiyyay. veiddach? im ken, lichtov o "gadol" "gadol", o "kashe" "kashe". may "gadol" umay "kashe"? shema minna tarte.

Bae rabbi elazar: shoro shel kohen gadol, bechamma? lemitat bealim dideh medammenan leh, o dilma lemitat bealim dealma medammenan leh? amar abbaye: middeka mibbaya leh shoro, michlal demamono peshita leh.
Peshita! mahu detema: hoil vechatav "kol haddavar haggadol", kol devarav shel gadol – ka mashma lan.
En motziin vechulei. menahane mille? amar rabbi avahu: deamar kera "velifne elazar hakkohen yaamod".
"Hu" – ze melech, "vechol bene yisrael itto" – ze meshuach milchama, "vechol haeda" – ze sanhedre.
Vedilma lesanhedre hu dekaamar lehu rachamana, delishayyeylu beurim vetummim?

Ella, ki ha deamar rav acha bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida: kinnor haya taluy lemala mimmittato shel david. kevan shehiggia chatzot layla, ruach tzefonit menashshevet bo vehaya menaggen meelav. miyyad haya david omed veosek betora ad sheala ammud hashshachar. kevan sheala ammud hashshachar, nichnesu chachme yisrael etzlo.

Amru lo: adonenu hammelech, ammecha yisrael tzerichin lefarnasa. amar lahen: lechu vehitparnesu ze mizze. amru lo: en hakkometz masbia et haari, veen habbor mitmalle mechuleyayto. amar lahem: lechu pishtu yedechem bigdud.
Miyyad yoatzin baachitofel, venimlachin besanhedrin, veshoalin beurim vetummim. amar rav yosef: may kera?
b: "Veachare achitofel benayahu ben yehoyada veevyatar vesar tzava lammelech yoav". "achitofel" – ze yoetz, vechen hu omer: "vaatzat achitofel asher yaatz vegomer". uvenayahu ben yehoyada" – zo sanhedrin. "evyatar" – ellu urim vetummim.

Vechen hu omer: "uvenayahu ben yehoyada al hakkereti veal happeleti". velamma nikra sheman kereti ufeleti? kereti – shekkortin divrehen, ufeleti – shemmufelain maasehen. veachar kach "sar hatztzava lammelech yoav".
Amar rabbi yitzchak bereh derav adda, veamri la amar rabbi yitzchak bar avudimi: may kera? "ura chevodi ura hannevel vechinnor aira shachar".
Veen mosifin al hair. menahane mille? amar rav shimi bar chiyyay, amar kera: "kechol asher ani mare otcha et tavnit hammishkan vechen taasu" – ledorot habbain.
Metiv rava: kol hakkelim sheasa moshe, meshichatan mekaddashtan. mikkan veelach, avodatan mechannachtan. veammay? nema "vechen taasu" ledorot habbain!
Shane hatam, deamar kera: "vayyimshachem vaykaddesh otam" – otam bimshicha, velo ledorot bimshicha.
Veema: otam bimshicha, uledorot – i bimshicha i baavoda? amar rav pappa: amar kera "asher yeshartu vam bakkodesh", hakkatuv telaan besherut.
Ella "otam" lema li? i lav "otam", hava amena: ledorot bimshicha uvaavoda, deha ketiv "vechen taasu". ketav rachamana "otam" – otam bimshicha, velo ledorot bimshicha.
Veen osin sanhedraot kulei. mena lan? kidashkechan bemoshe, deoki sanhedraot, umoshe bimkom shivim vechad kae.

Tanu rabbanan: minnayin shemmaamidin shoftim leyisrael? talmud lomar: "shoftim titten". shotrim leyisrael minnayin? talmud lomar: "shotrim titten". shoftim lechol shevet veshevet minnayin? talmud lomar: "shoftim lishvatecha". shotrim lechol shevet veshevet minnayin? talmud lomar: "shotrim lishvatecha".

Shoftim lechol ir vair minnayin? talmud lomar: "shoftim lisharecha". shotrim lechol ir vair minnayin? talmud lomar: "shotrim lisharecha". rabbi yehuda omer: echad memunne al kullan, shenneemar: "titten lecha". rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: "lishvatecha veshaftu" – mitzva bashshevet ladun et shivto.

Veen osin ir hanniddachat. mena hane mille? amar rabbi chiyyay bar yosef amar rabbi oshaya: deamar kera "vehotzeta et haish hahu o et haishsha hahi". ish veishsha atta motzi lisharecha, vei atta motzi kol hair kullah lisharecha.
En osin ir hanniddachat bassefar. may tama? "mikkirbecha" amar rachamana, velo min hassefar.

Velo shalosh are hanniddachat, dichtiv: "achat", aval osin achat o shetayim, dichtiv: "arecha". tanu rabbanan: "achat" – achat velo shalosh. atta omer: achat velo shalosh, o eno ella achat velo shetayim? keshehu omer: "arecha", hare shetayim amur. ha ma ani mekayyem "achat"? achat velo shalosh.

Zimnin amar rav: bevet din echad hu deen osin, ha bishnayim ushelosha batte dinin – osin. vezimnin amar rav: afillu bishnayim ushelosha batte dinin leolam en osin. may tama derav? mishshum korcha. amar resh lakish: lo shanu ella bemakom echad, aval bishnayim ushelosha mekomot – osin. rabbi yochanan amar: en osin mishshum korcha.

Tanya kevavteh derabbi yochanan: en osin shalosh ayayrot menuddachot beeretz yisrael, aval osin otam shetayim, kegon achat bihuda veachat baggalil. aval shetayim bihuda ushetayim baggalil – en osin. usemucha lassefar – afillu achat en osin. may tama? shemma yishmeu goyim veyachrivu et eretz yisrael.
Vetippok li demikkirbecha" amar rachamana, velo min hassefar? rabbi shimon hi, dedaresh tama dikra.
Sanhedri gedola hayta. may tamayyhu derabbanan deamri umoshe al gabbehen? amar kera: "vehityatztzevu sham

a: Immach", "immach" – veat bahadayyhu. verabbi yehuda: "immach" mishshum shechina.
Verabbanan, amar kera: "venasu ittecha bemassa haam", "ittecha" – veat bahadayyhu. verabbi yehuda: "ittecha" – bedomin lach.
Verabbanan, mivhakel mealecha venasu ittach" nafka. veyalfa sanhedri gedola missanhedri ketanna.
Tanu rabbanan: "vayyishshaaru shene anashim bammachane". yesh omrim: bakkalpi nishtayyeyru.

Shebbeshaa sheamar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: "esfa li shivim ish mizzikne yisrael", amar moshe: ketzad eese? evror shishsha mikkol shevet veshevet – nimtzeu shenayim yeterim. evror chamishsha chamishsha mikkol shevet veshevet – nimtzeu asara chaserim. evror shishsha mishshevet ze vachamishsha mishshevet ze – hareni metil kina ben hashshevatim.

Ma asa? berar shishsha shishsha, vehevi shivim ushenayim pitkin. al shivim katav "zaken", ushenayim hinniach chalak. belalan unetanan bekalpi. amar lahem: bou utelu pitkechem! kol mi sheala beyado "zaken", amar: kevar kiddeshcha shamayim. mi sheala beyado chalak, amar: hammakom lo chafetz becha, ani ma eese lach?
Keyotze baddavar atta omer: "velakachta chameshet chameshet shekalim laggulgolet". amar moshe: ketzad eese lahen leyisrael? im omar lo: ten li pidyoncha vatze, yomar li: kevar pedaani ben levi.

Ma asa? hevi esrim ushenayim alafim pitkin, vechatav alehen "ben levi", veal shelosha veshivim umatayim katav alehen "chamishsha shekalim". belalan unetanan bekalpi. amar lahen: telu pitkechem. mi sheala beyado "ben levi", amar lo: kevar pedaacha ben levi. mi sheala beyado "chameshet shekalim", amar lo: ten pidyoncha vatze.

Rabbi shimon omer: bammachane nishtayyeyru. beshaa sheamar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe "esfa li shivim ish", amru eldad umedad: en anu reuyin leotah gedulla. amar hakkadosh baruch hu: hoil umiattem atzmechem, hareni mosif gedulla al gedullatchem. uma gedulla hosif lahem? shehanneviim kullan nitnabbeu ufasku, vehem nitnabbeu velo pasku.
Uma nevua nitnabbeu? amru: moshe met, yehoshua machnis et yisrael laaretz. abba chanin omer mishshum rabbi eliezer: al iske selav hen mitnabbeim: ali selav, ali selav.

Rav nachman amar: al iske gog umagog hayu mitnabbein, shenneemar: "ko amar Adonai elohim haatta hu asher dibbarti beyamim kadmonim beyad avaday nevie yisrael hannibbeim bayyamim hahem shanim lehavi otcha alehem vegomer". al tikre "shanim" ella "shenayim". ellu hen shenayim neviim shennitnabbeu beferek echad nevua achat? heve omer: eldad umedad.

Amar mar: kol hanneviim kullan nitnabbeu ufasku, vehen nitnabbeu velo pasku. mena lan defasku? illema middichtiv: "vayyitnabbeu velo yasafu"? ella meatta: "kol gadol velo yasaf" – hachi name dela osef hu? ella dela pesak hu!
Ella, hacha ketiv: "vayyitnabbeu", hatam ketiv: "mitnabbeim". adayin mitnabbeim veholchim.
Bishlama leman deamar moshe met, hayeynu dichtiv "adoni moshe kelaem". ella leman deamar hanach tarte, may "adoni moshe kelaem"? delav orach ara, dehave leh ketalmid hammore halacha lifne rabbo.
Bishlama leman deamar hanach tarte, hayeynu dichtiv: "mi yitten". ella leman deamar moshe met, menach hava nicha leh? la sayyeymuha kammeh.
May "kelaem"? amar leh: hattel alehen tzorche tzibbur, vehen kalin meelehen.
Minnayin lehavi od shelosha?

Sof sof, leraa al pi shenayim la mashkachat la. i achad asar mezakkin ushenem asar mechayyeyvin – akkatti chad hu. i asara mezakkin ushelosha asar mechayyeyvin – telata havu. amar rabbi avahu: i atta motze ella bemosifin, vedivre hakkol, uvesanhedri gedola, veallibba derabbi yehuda deamar shivim.

Veamar rabbi avahu: bemosifin osin bet din shakul lechattechilla. peshita! mahu detema: hay dekaamar "eni yodea" keman deiteh dame, vei amar milleta – shaminan leh; ka mashma lan dehay dekaamar "eni yodea" keman deleteh dame, vei amar tama – la shaminan leh.
Amar rav kahana: sanhedri sherau kullan lechova – potrin oto. may tama? kevan digmiri halanat din lemebad leh zechuta, vehane tu la chazu leh.
Amar rabbi yochanan: en moshivin besanhedri ella baale koma, uvaale chochma, uvaale mare, uvaale zikna, uvaale cheshafim, veyodim beshivim lashon – shello tehe sanhedri shomaat mippi hameturegman.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: en moshivin besanhedrin ella mi sheyyodea letaher et hashsheretz min hattora. amar rav: ani adun vaataharennu.
b: Uma nachash shemmemit umarbe tumea, tahor; sheretz sheeno memit umarbe tumea, eno din sheyyehe tahor? vela hi, midde dehave akkotz bealma.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol ir sheen bah shenayim ledabber veechad lishmoa, en moshivin bah sanhedri. uvevetter havo shelosha, uveyavne arbaa: rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva, veshimon hattimni dan lifnehem bakkarka.
Metivi: shelishit – chachama, reviit – en lemala hemenna. hu deamar ki hay tanna, detanya: sheniyya – chachama, shelishit – en lemala hemenna.

Lemedin lifne chachamim – levi merabbi. danin lifne chachamim – shimon ben azzay, veshimon ben zoma, vechanan hammitzri, vachananya ben chachinay. rav nachman bar yitzchak matne chamishsha: shimon, shimon, veshimon, chanan, vachananya.

Rabbotenu shebbevavel – rav ushemuel. rabbotenu shebbeeretz yisrael – rabbi abba. dayyayne gola – karna. dayyayne deeretz yisrael – rabbi amme verabbi assi. dayyayne defumebdita – rav pappa bar shemuel. dayyayne dinhardea – rav adda bar minyome. save desura – rav huna verav chisda. save defumebdita – rav yehuda verav ena. charife defumebdita – efa vaavimi bene rachava. amorae defumebdita – rabba verav yosef. amorae dinhardae – rav chama.

Neharbelae matnu – rame bar berabbi. amri be rav – rav huna. vehaamar rav huna: "amri be rav"! ella, rav hamenuna. amri bemareva – rabbi yirmeya. shelachu mittam – rabbi yose bar chanina. machachu ala bemareva – rabbi elazar.
Veha shelachu mittam: ledivre rabbi yose bar chanina! ella efoch: shelachu mittam – rabbi elazar; machachu ala bemareva – rabbi yose bar chanina.

Vechamma yehe bair vihe reuya lesanhedrin? mea veesrim vechulei. mea veesrim may avidtayyhu? esrim ushelosha keneged sanhedri ketanna, veshalosh shurot shel esrim ushelosha – hare tishim vetarte, vaasara batlanin shel bet hakkeneset – hare mea utere.
Ushene sofrim, ushene chazzanin, ushene baale dinin, ushene edim, ushene zommin, ushene zomme zommin – hare mea vearbesar.

Vetanya: kol ir sheen bah asara devarim hallalu en talmid chacham rashshay ladur betochah: bet din makkin veonshin, vekuppa shel tzedaka nigbet bishnayim umitchalleket bishlosha, uvet hakkeneset, uvet hammerchatz, uvet hakkisse, rofe, veumman, velavlar, vetabbach, umelammed tinokot. mishshum rabbi akiva amru: af mine fera, mippene shemmine fera meirin et haenayim.
Rabbi nechemya omer vechulei. tanya, rabbi omer:

a: Matayim veshivim veshiva.
Vehatanya, rabbi omer: matayim shivim ushemona! la kashya: ha – rabbi yehuda, ha – rabbanan.

Tanu rabbanan: "vesamta alehem sare alafim sare meot sare chamishshim vesare asarot". "sare alafim" – shesh meot, "sare meot" – sheshet alafim, "sare chamishshim" – shenem asar elef, "sare asarot" – sheshet ribbo. nimtzeu dayyayne yisrael shivat ribbo ushemonat alafim veshesh meot.
Hadaran alach dine mamonot.
Mishna kohen gadol dan vedanin oto, meid umeidin oto, choletz vecholtzin leishto, umeyaybmin et ishto. aval hu eno meyaybem, mippene shehu asur baalmana.
Met lo met, eno yotze achar hammitta, ella hen nichsin vehu nigle, hen niglin vehu nichse, veyotze immahen ad petach shaar hair, divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi yehuda omer: eno yotze min hammikdash, mishshum shenneemar: "umin hammikdash lo yetze".

Ucheshehu menachem acherim, derech kol haam ovrin beze achar ze, vehamemunne mematztzeo beno leven haam. ucheshehu mitnachem meacherim, kol haam omrim lo: anachnu kapparatcha, vehu omer lahen: titbarchu min hashshamayim. ucheshemmavrin oto, kol haam mesubbin al haaretz, vehu mesev al hassafsal.

Hammelech lo dan, velo danin oto, lo meid velo meidin oto, lo choletz velo choltzin leishto, lo meyaybem velo meyaybmin leishto. rabbi yehuda omer: im ratza lachalotz o leyaybem – zachur lattov. amru lo: en shomin lo.

Veen nosin almenato, rabbi yehuda omer: nose hammelech almenato shel melech, shekken matzinu bedavid shennasa almenato shel shaul, shenneemar: "vaettena lecha et bet adonecha veet neshe adonecha bechekecha".

Gemara kohen gadol dan. peshita! danin oto itztericha leh. ha name peshita: i la dayyninan leh, ihu hechi dayen? vehachtiv "hitkoshshu vakoshshu", veamar resh lakish: keshot atzmecha veachar kach keshot acherim.

Ella, ayyeyde deka bae lemitne melech lo dan velo danin oto, tena name kohen gadol dan vedanin. vei baet ema, ha ka mashma lan kidtanya: kohen gadol sheharag et hannefesh bemezid – neherag, beshogeg – gole, veover al ase veal lo taase, vahare hu kehedyot lechol devarav.
Bemezid neherag – peshita! beshogeg gole itztericha leh.
Ha name peshita! itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil uchetiv "veyashav bah ad mot hakkohen haggadol", ema: kol deit leh takkanta bachazara – ligle, delet leh takkanta bachazara – la ligle, ditnan:
b: Hahoreg kohen gadol, o kohen gadol sheharag et hannefesh – eno yotze mishsham leolam; ema la ligle – ka mashma lan. veema hachi name? amar kera "lanus shamma kol rotzeach" – afillu kohen gadol bammashma.
Over al ase veal lo taase. la saggi dela avar? hachi kaamar: im avar al ase veal lo taase, hare hu kehedyot lechol devarav.

Peshita! salka datach amena, hoil utenan: en danin lo et hashshevet velo et nevi hashsheker velo et kohen gadol ella al pi bet din shel shivim veechad, veamar rav adda bar ahava: "kol haddavar haggadol yaviu elecha" – devarav shel gadol, ema kol devarav shel gadol, ka mashma lan.
Veema hachi name: mi ketiv divre gadol? "haddavar haggadol" ketiv, davar gadol mammash.
Meid umeidin oto. meid? vehatanya: "vehitallamta" – peamim sheatta mitallem, ufeamim shei atta mitallem. ha ketzad?
Kohen vehu bevet hakkevarot, zaken veenah lefi kevodo, o shehayta melacha shello merubba mishshel chavero – lechach neemar "vehitallamta".
Amar rav yosef: meid lammelech. vehatnan: lo dan velo danin oto, lo meid velo meidin oto? ella amar rabbi zera: meid leven melech. ben melech hedyot hu!
Ella, meid bifne hammelech. veha en moshivin melech besanhedrin! mishshum yekara dechohen gadol ata veyatev. mekabbeli nihaleh lesahaduteh, kae hu veazel, umeayyeynina leh anan bedineh.
Gufa: en moshivin melech bassanhedrin, velo melech vechohen gadol beibbur shana. melech bassanhedrin – dichtiv: "lo taane al riv" – lo taane al rav.
Lo melech vechohen gadol beibbur shana. melech – mishshum afsanya, kohen gadol – mishshum tzinna.
Amar rav pappa: shema minna, shatta batar yarcha azel. ini? veha hanach shelosha roe vakar dahavo kayymi, veshaminhu rabbanan dekaamri:

Chad amar: im bakkir velakkish kachada yenetz – den hu adar, veim lav – let den adar. vechad amar: im tor bitzfar bitlag yemut, uvetihara betul teena yidmoch yashlach mashkeh – den hu adar, veim lav – let den adar. vechad amar: im kiddum takkif lachada yehe, yippach beloach nafek lekivleh – den hu adar, veim lav – let den adar. veabberuha rabbanan lehahi shatta.
Vetisbera rabbanan araavota semuch? ella, rabbanan achushebanayyhu semuch, veroe vakar istayyoe hu deistayyaya milletayyhu.
Choletz vecholtzin kulei. ka pasek vetane, la shena min haerusin vela shena min hannissuin. bishlama min hannissuin, have ase velo taase -

a: Veen ase doche lo taase vaase. ella min haerusin ammay? yavo ase veyidche lo taase!
Gezera bia rishona, attu bia sheniyya.
Tanya name hachi: im kadmu uvaalu bia rishona – kanu, veasur lekayyeyman bevia sheniyya.
Met lo met kulei. tanu rabbanan: "umin hammikdash lo yetze" – lo yetze immahen, aval yotze hu acharehen. ketzad? hen nichsin vehu nigle, hen niglin vehu nichse.
Veyotze ad petach kulei. shappir kaamar rabbi yehuda.
Amar lach rabbi meir: i hachi, leveto name la! ella hachi kaamar: "min hammikdash lo yetze" – mikkedushshato lo yetze. vechevan deit leh hekkera, la ate leminga.
Verabbi yehuda: aggav merareh, dilma mikkere veate venaga.

Keshehu menachem. tanu rabbanan: keshehu over bashshura lenachem et acherim – segan umashuach sheavar bimino, verosh bet av vaavelim vechol haam missemolo. ucheshehu omed bashshura umitnachem meacherim – segan mimino, verosh bet av vechol haam missemolo.

Aval mashuach sheavar la ate gabbeh. may tama? chalsha dateh. savar: ka chade bi. amar rav pappa: shema minna meha matnita telat. shema minna: hayeynu segan hayeynu memunne, ushema minna: avelim omdin vechol haam ovrin, ushema minna: avelim lismol hamenachamin hen omdin.

Tanu rabbanan: barishona hayu avelim omdin, vechol haam ovrin. vehayu shete mishpachot birushalayim mitgarot zo bazo, zot omeret: "ani overet techilla", vezot omeret: "ani overet techilla". hitkinu sheyyehe haam omdin vaavelim ovrin.
(Chazar, vehalach, vesipper. siman).

Amar rame bar abba: hechzir rabbi yose et haddavar leyoshno betzippori, sheyyihyu avelim omdin vechol haam ovrin. veamar rame bar abba: hitkin rabbi yose betzippori shello tehe ishsha mehallechet bashshuk uvenah achareha, mishshum maase shehaya. veamar rame bar abba: hitkin rabbi yose betzippori sheyyihyu nashim mesapperot bevet hakkisse, mishshum yichud.

Amar rav menashsheya bar ut: sheelit et rabbi yoshiyya rabba bevet almin dehutzal, veamar li: en shura pechuta measara bene adam, veen avelim min hamminyan. ben sheavelim omdin vechol haam ovrin, ben sheavelim ovrin vechol haam omdin.

Keshehu mitnachem kulei. ibbaya lehu: ki menachem hu acharine, hechi amar lehu? ta shema: vehu omer titnachamu. hechi dame? illema ki menachami acharine ledideh, amar lehu ihu titnachamu? nechasha ka rame lehu! ella, ki menachem leacharine amar lehu titnachamu. shema minna.

Melech lo dan kulei. amar rav yosef: lo shanu ella malche yisrael, aval malche bet david dan vedanin otan, dichtiv: "bet david ko amar Adonai dinu labboker mishpat". vei la dayyninan leh, inhu hechi dayyni? vehachtiv: "hitkoshshu vakoshshu", veamar resh lakish: keshot atzmecha veachar kach keshot acherim.

Ella malche yisrael may tama la? mishshum maase shehaya, deavdeh deyannay malka ketal nafsha. amar lehu shimon ben shatach lachachamim: tenu enechem bo unedunennu. shelachu leh: avdach ketal nafsha. shaddereh lehu. shelachu leh: ta ant name lehacha, "vehuad bivalav" amra tora – yavo baal hashshor veyaamod al shoro.

Ata vitev. amar leh shimon ben shatach: yannay hammelech, amod al raglecha veyaidu bach. velo lefanenu atta omed, ella lifne mi sheamar vehaya haolam atta omed, shenneemar: "veamdu shene haanashim asher lahem hariv vego". amar lo: lo keshettomar atta, ella kema sheyyomru chaverecha.
b: Nifna limino – kavshu penehem bakkarka. nifna lismolo – vechavshu penehem bakkarka. amar lahen shimon ben shatach: baale machshavot attem, yavo baal machshavot veyippara mikkem! miyyad ba gavriel vachavatan bakkarka, umetu. beotah shaa amru: melech lo dan velo danin oto, lo meid velo meidin oto.

Lo choletz velo choltzin vechulei. ini? vehaamar rav ashe: afillu leman deamar nasi shemmachal al kevodo – kevodo machul, melech shemmachal al kevodo – en kevodo machul, shenneemar: "som tasim alecha melech", shettehe emato alecha! mitzva shane.
Veen nosin kulei. tanya, amru lo lerabbi yehuda: nashim haruyot lo mibbet hammelech. umay ninhu? merav umichal.

Shaalu talmidav et rabbi yose: heach nasa david shete achayot bechayyehen? amar lahen: michal achar mitat merav nesaah. rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: kiddushe taut hayu lo bemerav, shenneemar: "tena et ishti et michal asher erasti li bemea orlot pelishtim".
May talmuda? amar rav pappa: "michal ishti", velo merav ishti.
May kiddushe taut? dichtiv: "vehaya haish asher yakkennu yasherennu hammelech osher gadol vegomer". azal katleh. amar lo: milva it lach gabbay, vehamekaddesh bemilve enah mekuddeshet.

Azal yahava leadriel, dichtiv: "vayhi beet tet et merav bat shaul ledavid vegomer". amar leh: i baet deetten lach michal, zil ayyti li mea orlot pelishtim. azal ayyti leh. amar leh: milva uferuta it lach gabbay.
Shaul sevar: milva uferuta – dateh ammilva, vedavid sevar: milva uferuta – dateh apperuta.
Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma milva uferuta – dateh apperuta. shaul sevar: la chazu vela midde, vedavid sevar: chazo lechalve veshunnare.
Verabbi yose, hay "tena et ishti et michal" may daresh beh? rabbi yose letameh, detanya: rabbi yose haya doresh mikraot meoravin.

Ketiv: "vayyikkach hammelech et shene bene ritzpa vat ayya asher yalda leshaul et armoni veet mefivoshet veet chameshet bene michal asher yalda leadriel hammecholati vegomer". vechi leadriel nittena? vahalo lefalti ben layish nittena! dichtiv: "veshaul natan et michal bitto eshet david lefalti ven layish vegomer".
Ella makkish kiddushe merav leadriel lekiddushe michal lefalti: ma kiddushe michal lefalti – baavera, af kiddushe merav leadriel – baavera.

Verabbi yehoshua ben korcha name, hachtiv: "et chameshet bene michal bat shaul"? amar lecha rabbi yehoshua: vechi michal yalda? vahalo merav yalda! merav yalda umichal giddela, lefichach nikreu al shemah. lelammedcha shekkol hamegaddel yatom betoch beto maale alav hakkatuv keillu yelado.

(Chanina kara yochanan veishto elazar ugeulla ushemuel belimmudo siman.) rabbi chanina omer, mehacha: "vattikrena lo hashshechenot shem lemor yullad ben lenoomi". vechi noomi yalda? vahalo rut yalda! ella rut yalda venoomi giddela, lefichach nikra al shemah.

Rabbi yochanan amar, mehacha: "veishto hayehudiyya yalda et yered avi gedor vegomer veelle bene bitya vat paro asher lakach (lo) mared". mared ze kalev, velamma nikra shemo mered? shemmarad baatzat meraggelim. vechi bitya yalda? vahalo yocheved yalda! ella yocheved yalda uvitya giddela, lefichach nikra al shemah.
Rabbi elazar amar, mehacha: "gaalta bizroa ammecha bene yaakov veyosef sela". vechi yosef yalad? vahalo yaakov yalad! ella, yaakov yalad veyosef kilkel, lefichach nikreu al shemo.

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol hamelammed ben chavero tora, maale alav hakkatuv keillu yelado, shenneemar: "veelle toldot aharon umoshe", uchetiv: "veelle shemot bene aharon". lomar lach: aharon yalad umoshe limmed, lefichach nikreu al shemo.

"Lachen ko amar Adonai el bet yaakov asher pada et avraham", vechi hechan matzinu beyaakov sheppedao leavraham? amar rav yehuda: sheppedao mitztzaar giddul banim. vehayeynu dichtiv: "lo atta yevosh yaakov vegomer", "lo atta yevosh yaakov" – meaviv, "velo atta panav yechevaru" – meavi aviv.

Ketiv "palti" uchetiv "paltiel". amar rabbi yochanan: palti shemo, velamma nikra shemo paltiel? sheppilleto el min haavera. ma asa? naatz cherev beno levenah. amar: kol haosek bedavar ze yiddaker becharev (ze).
Vehachtiv: "vayyelech ittah ishah"? shennaasa lah keishah. vehachtiv: "haloch uvacho"? al mitzva daazayl minneh. "ad bachurim", shennaasu shenehem kevachurim, shello taamu taam bia.

Amar rabbi yochanan: tokpo shel yosef – invevtanuto shel boaz, tokpo shel boaz – invevtanuto shel palti ben layish. tokpo shel yosef – invevtanuto shel boaz, dichtiv: "vayhi bachatzi hallayla vayyecherad haish vayyillafet". may "vayyillafet"? amar rav: shennaasa besaro kerashe lefatot.

a: Tokpo shel boaz – invevtanuto shel palti ben layish, kedaamaran.
Amar rabbi yochanan: may dichtiv "rabbot banot asu chayil veat alit al kullana"? "rabbot banot asu chayil" – ze yosef uvoaz. "veat alit al kullana" – ze palti ben layish.

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachman amar rabbi yonatan: may dichtiv "sheker hachen vehevel hayyofi"? "sheker hachen" – ze yosef, "vehevel hayyofi" – ze boaz. "yirat Adonai hi tithallal" – ze palti ben layish.
Davar acher: "sheker hachen" – ze doro shel moshe, "vehevel hayyofi" – ze doro shel yehoshua, "yirat Adonai hi tithallal" – ze doro shel chizkiyya.

Davar acher: "sheker hachen" – ze doro shel moshe vihoshua. "vehevel hayyofi" – ze doro shel chizkiyya. "yirat Adonai hi tithallal" – ze doro shel rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay. amru alav al rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay, shehayu shishsha talmidim mitkassin betallit achat veoskin battora.

Mishna met lo met – eno yotze mippetach palterin shello. rabbi yehuda omer: im rotze latzet achar hammitta – yotze, shekken matzinu bedavid sheyyatza achar mittato shel avner, shenneemar: "vehammelech david holech achar hammitta". amru lo: lo haya haddavar ella lefayyes et haam. ucheshemmavrin oto – kol heam mesubbin al haaretz, vehu mesev al haddargesh.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: makom shennahagu nashim latzet achar hammitta – yotzot, lifne hammitta – yotzot. rabbi yehuda omer: leolam nashim lifne hammitta yotzot, shekken matzinu bedavid sheyyatza achar mittato shel avner, shenneemar: "vehammelech david holech achar hammitta".

Amru lo: lo haya haddavar ella lefayyes et haam, venitpayyeysu. shehaya david yotze mibben haanashim venichnas leven hannashim, veyotze mibben hannashim venichnas leven haanashim, shenneemar: "vayyedu chol haam vechol yisrael ki lo hayta mehammelech lehamit et avner".
Daresh rava, may dichtiv: "vayyavo chol haam lehaverot et david"? ketiv "lehacherot", vekarenan "lehaverot". battechilla lehacheroto, ulevassof lehaveroto.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: mippene ma neenash avner? mippene shehaya lo lemachot beshaul velo micha. rabbi yitzchak amar: micha velo naana. ushenehen mikra echad darshu: "vaykonen hammelech el avner vayyomar hakkemot naval yamut avner yadecha lo asurot veraglecha lo linchushtayim huggashu".

Man deamar la micha, hachi kaamar: "yadecha lo asurot veraglecha lo linchushtayim huggashu", may tama la machet? "kinfol lifne vene avla nafalta". uman deamar micha velo naana, atmohe matma: "hakkemot naval yamut"? "yadecha lo asurot veraglecha lo linchushtayim", mikkede machoye machet, may tama "kinfol lifne vene avla nafalta"?
Leman deamar micha, may tama ianash? amar rav nachman berabbi yitzchak: sheshshiha malchut bet david shete shanim umechetza.
Ucheshemmavrin oto kulei. may dargesh? amar ulla: arsa degadda. amaru leh rabbanan leulla: mi ikka midde dead haiddana la otvinneh, vehasheta motvinan leh?

Matkef la rava: may kusheya? dilma midde dehave aachila ushetiyya, dead haiddana la ochylinneh vela ashkinneh, hasheta ka mochlinan leh veka mashkinan leh. ella i kashya, ha kashya: dargesh eno tzarich lichpoto, ella zokfo. vei salka datach arsa degadda, ammay eno tzarich lichpoto? vehatanya: hakkofe et mittato, lo mittato bilvad hu kofe, ella kol mittot sheyyesh lo betoch beto hu kofe.

May kusheya? dilma midde dehave ammitta meyuchedet lechelim, dekatane: im hayta meyuchedet lechelim – eno tzarich lichpotah. ella, i kashya – ha kashya: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: dargesh – mattir karbitin vehu nofel meelav. vei salka datach arsa degadda, karbitin mi it leh?
Ella, ki ata ravin amar: amar li hahu merabbanan, verav tachlifa shemeh, dahava shechiach beshuka degildae, vaamar leh: may dargesh? arsa detzalla. amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi yochanan: dargesh —
b: Serugo mittocho, mitta – serugah meal gabbah.

Metivi: kele etz, meematay mekabbelin tumea? hammitta vehaarisa – mishsheyyeshufem beor haddag. vei mitta mesoreget hi meal gabbah, lema li shifat or haddag? ella, ha veha mittocho: mitta – aole veappoke bevizyone, dargesh – aole veappoke beavkata.
Amar rabbi yaakov: amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel. amar rabbi yaakov bar amme: mitta shennakliteha yotzin – zokfah, vedayyo.

Mishna umotzi lemilchemet harshut al pi bet din shel shivim veechad, uforetz laasot lo derech veen memache beyado. derech hammelech en lo shiur, vechol haam bozzin venotnin lo, vehu notel chelek barosh.
Gemara tenena chada zimna: en motziin lemilchemet harshut ella al pi bet din shel shivim veechad. ayyeyde ditna kol mille demelech, tena name motziin lemilchemet harshut.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol haamur befarashat melech – melech muttar bo. rav amar: lo neemra parasha zo ella leayyem alehem, shenneemar: "som tasim alecha melech" – shettehe emato alecha.

Ketannae, rabbi yose omer: kol haamur befarashat melech – melech muttar bo. rabbi yehuda omer: lo neemra parasha zo ella kede leayyem alehem, shenneemar: "som tasim alecha melech" – shettehe emato alecha.
Vechen haya rabbi yehuda omer: shalosh mitzvot nitztauu yisrael bichnisatan laaretz – lehaamid lahem melech, ulehachrit zaro shel amalek, velivnot lahem bet habbechira.
Rabbi nehoray omer: lo neemra parasha zo ella keneged taromtan, shenneemar: "veamarta asima alay melech vegomer".

Tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: zekenim shebbaddor kahogen shaalu, shenneemar: "tena lanu melech leshoftenu". aval amme haaretz shebbahen kilkelu, shenneemar: "vehayinu gam anachnu kechol haggoyim ushefatanu malkenu veyatza lefanenu".
Tanya, rabbi yose omer: shalosh mitzvot nitztauu yisrael bichnisatan laaretz – lehaamid lahem melech, ulehachrit zaro shel amalek, velivnot lahem bet habbechira. veeni yodea eze mehen techilla.
Keshehu omer: "ki yad al kes yah milchama laAdonai baamalek", heve omer: lehaamid lahem melech techilla. veen "kisse" ella melech, shenneemar: "vayyeshev shelomo al kisse Adonai lemelech".

Vaadayin eni yodea im livnot lahem bet habbechira techilla, o lehacherit zaro shel amalek techilla. keshehu omer: "veheniach lachem mikkol oyvechem vegomer vehaya hammakom asher yivchar Adonai vegomer", heve omer: lehacherit zaro shel amalek techilla.
Vechen bedavid hu omer: "vayhi ki yashav hammelech david beveto vaAdonai heniach lo missaviv", uchetiv: "vayyomer hammelech el natan hannavi ree na anochi yoshev bevet arazim vegomer".

Amar resh lakish: battechilla malach shelomo al haelyonim, shenneemar: "vayyeshev shelomo al kisse Adonai", ulevassof malach al hattachtonim, shenneemar: "ki hu rode bechol ever hannahar mittifsach vead azza".
Rav ushemuel: chad amar, "tifsach besof haolam veazza besof haolam", vechad amar, "tifsach veazza bahade hadade havo yatvi", ucheshem shemmalach al tifsach veal azza kach malach al kol haolam kullo.

Ulevassof lo malach ella al yisrael, shenneemar: "ani kohelet hayiti melech al yisrael vegomer". ulevassof lo malach ella al yerushalayim, shenneemar: "divre kohelet ben david melech birushalaym". ulevassof, lo malach ella al mittato, shenneemar: "hinne mittato shellishlomo vegomer".
Ulevassof lo malach ella al maklo, shenneemar: "ze haya chelki mikkol amali". rav ushemuel: chad amar maklo, vechad amar gunedo.
Hadar o la hadar? rav ushemuel: chad amar hadar, vechad amar la hadar. man deamar la hadar – melech vehedyot, uman deamar hadar – melech vehedyot vamelech.

Poretz laasot lo derech. tanu rabbanan: otzrot melachim – lammelech, ushear bizza shebbozzin – mechetza lammelech umechetza laam. amar leh abbaye lerav dimi, veamri la lerav acha: bishlama otzrot melachim lammelech – orcha demilleta, ella shear bizza shebbozzin mechetza lammelech umechetza laam – menalan? dichtiv:

a: "Vayyimshechu laAdonai lenagid uletzadok", makkish nagid letzadok: ma tzadok – mechetza lo umechetza leechav, af nagid – mechetza lo umechetza leechav.
Vetzadok gufeh menalan? detanya: rabbi omer: "vehayta leaharon ulevanav" – mechetza leaharon umechetza levanav.

Mishna "lo yarbe lo nashim", ella shemone esre. rabbi yehuda omer: marbe hu lo, uvilvad shello yehu mesirot et libbo. rabbi shimon omer: afillu achat umesira et libbo – hare ze lo yissaenna. im ken, lamma neemar "lo yarbe lo nashim"? daafillu kaavigayil.
Gemara lememra derabbi yehuda daresh tama dikra, verabbi shimon la daresh tama dikra? veha ippecha shaminan lehu!

Detanya: almana, ben shehi aniyya ben shehi ashira, en memashkenin otah, shenneemar: "lo tachavol beged almana" – divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer: ashira – memashkenin otah, aniyyay – en memashkenin otah, veatta chayyayv lehachezir lah, veatta massiah shem ra bishchenoteha.

Veamrinan: may kaamar? hachi kaamar: mittoch sheatta memashkenah, atta chayyayv lehachazir lah, veatta massiah shem ra bishchenoteha. alma, rabbi yehuda la daresh tama dikra, verabbi shimon daresh tama dikra.
Bealma, rabbi yehuda la daresh tama dikra, veshane hacha dimfaresh tama dikra: ma taam "lo yarbe lo nashim"? mishshum delo yasur levavo".

Verabbi shimon amar lach: mikkedi bealma darshinan tama dikra, im ken lichtov kera "lo yarbe lo nashim" velishtok, vaana amena: ma taam "lo yarbe"? mishshum delo yasur". "lo yasur" lema li? afillu achat umesira et libbo – hare zo lo yissaenna. ella ma ani mekayyem "lo yarbe"? daafillu kaavigayil.

Hane shemone esre menalan? dichtiv: "vayyivvaldu ledavid banim bechevron vayhi vechoro amnon laachinoam hayyizreelit. umishnehu chilav laavigayil eshet naval hakkarmeli vehashshelishi avshalom ben maacha ... veharvii adoniyya ven chaggit vehachamishi shefatya ven avital. vehashshishshi yitream leegla eshet david elle yulledu ledavid bechevron".
Vekaamar leh navi: "im meat, veosifa lecha kahenna vechahenna". "kahenna" – shet, "vechahenna" – shet, dehavu lehu tamne sere.
Matkef la ravina: emar, "kahenna" – tarte sere, "vechahenna" – esrin vearba.
Tanya name hachi: "lo yarbe lo nashim" – yoter meesrim vearba. leman dedaresh vav, arbaim ushemone havu. tanya name hachi: "lo yarbe lo nashim" – yoter mearbaim ushemone.
Vetanna didan, may tameh? amar rav kahana: makkish "kahenna" batra lekahenna" kamma: ma "kahenna" kamma – shet, af "kahenna" batra – shet.
Veha havay michal! amar rav: egla zo michal, velamma nikra shemah egla? shechaviva alav keegla. vechen hu omer: "lule charashtem beeglati vegomer".
Umi havo lemichal bene? vehachtiv: "ulemichal bat shaul lo haya lah valad ad yom motah"! amar rav chisda: ad yom motah lo haya lah, beyom motah haya lah.

Mikkede, banim hecha ka chashev lehu? bechevron. veillu maase demichal birushalayim hava, dichtiv: "umichal bat shaul nishkefa bead hachallon vattere et hammelech david mefazzez umecharker lifne Adonai vattivez". veamar rav yehuda, veittema rav yosef: shekalte michal lemitrafsa! ella ema: ad oto maase – haya lah, mikkan veelach – lo haya lah.

Vehachtiv: "vayyikkach david od pilagshim venashim birushalayim"? lemalloye shemona esre. may "nashim" umay "pilagshim"? amar rav yehuda amar rav: nashim – bichtubba uvekiddushin, pilagshim – belo ketubba uvelo kiddushin.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: arba meot yeladim hayu lo ledavid, vechullan bene yefat toar hayu, umegaddele veloriyyot hayu, vechullan yoshvin bikronot shel zahav, umehallechin berashe geyaysot hayu, vehem hayu baale egrofin shel bet david.

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav: tamar bat yefat toar hayta, shenneemar: "veatta dabber na el hammelech ki lo yimnaeni mimmekka". vei salka datach bat nissuin havay, achateh mi hava sharya leh? ella shema minna: bat yefat toar hayta.
"Uleamnon rea ushemo yonadav ben shima achi david veyonadav ish chacham vegomer". amar rav yehuda amar rav: ish chacham lerisha.

"Vayyomer ... maddua atta kacha dal ben hammelech ... vayyomer lo yonadav shechav al mishkavcha vehitchal vegomer", ad "veasta leenay et habbirya". "vattikkach hammasret vattitzok lefanav". amar rav yehuda amar rav: sheasta lo mine tiggun.
"Vayyisnaeha amnon sina gedola meod". may tama? amar rabbi yitzchak: nima nikshera lo vaasaattu kerut shofcha. vechi nikshera lo, ihi may avada? ella ema: kashra lo nima vaasaattu kerut shofcha.
Ini? veha daresh rava: may dichtiv "vayyetze lach shem baggoyim beyofyech"? sheen lahen livnot yisrael lo sear bet hashshechi vela bet haerva! shane tamar, devat yefat toar havay.

"Vattikkach tamar efer al roshah veet ketonet happassim asher aleha karaa". tana mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben korcha: gader gadol gadra tamar beotah shaa. amru: livnot melachim kach, livnot hedyotot al achat kamma vechamma. im latztzenuot kach, lapperutzot al achat kamma vechamma. amar rav yehuda amar rav: beotah shaa gazru
b: Al hayyichud, veal happenuya.

Yichud? deorayyta hu! deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak: remez leyichud min hattora minnayin? shenneemar: "ki yesitcha achicha ven immecha". vechi ben em mesit, ben av eno mesit? ella lomar lach: ben mityayched im immo, veen acher mityayched im kol arayot shebbattora.
Ella ema: gazru al yichud difnuya.
"Vaadoniyya ven chaggit mitnasse lemor ani emloch". amar rav yehuda amar rav: melammed shebbikkesh leholmo, velo holamto.
"Vayyaas lo rechev ufarashim vachamishshim ish ratzim lefanav". may revuta? amar rav yehuda amar rav: kullan netule techol vachakuke kappot raglayim hayu.

Mishna "lo yarbe lo susim", ella kede merkavto. "vechesef vezahav lo yarbe lo meod", ella kede litten afsanya. vechotev lo sefer tora lishmo. yotze lammilchama – motziah immo, nichnas – hu machnisah immo, yoshev baddin – hi immo, mesev – hi kenegdo, shenneemar: "vehayta immo vekara vo kol yeme chayyav".

Gemara tanu rabbanan: "lo yarbe lo susim" – yachol afillu kede merkavto ufarashav? talmud lomar "lo" – lo eno marbe, aval marbe hu kede richbo ufarashav. ha ma ani mekayyem "susim"? susim habbatlanin. minnayin sheafillu sus echad vehu batel shehu belo yarbe"? talmud lomar "lemaan harebot sus".
Vechi meachar daafillu sus echad vehu batel kae belo yarbe", "susim" lema li? laavor belo taase al kol sus vesus.
Tama dichtav rachamana "lo", ha lav hachi hava amena afillu kede richbo ufarashav name la? la tzericha, leapposhe.

"Vechesef vezahav lo yarbe lo", ella kede litten afsanya. tanu rabbanan: "vechesef vezahav lo yarbe lo" – yachol afillu kede litten afsanya? talmud lomar "lo" – lo eno marbe, aval marbe hu kede litten afsanya.
Tama dichtav rachamana "lo"? ha lav hachi, hava amena: afillu kede litten afsanya name la? la tzericha, leharevavcha.
Hasheta deamrat "lo" lidrasha, "lo yarbe lo nashim" may darshat beh? lemaote hedyotot.

Rav yehuda rame: ketiv "vayhi lishlomo arbaim elef urvot susim lemerkavto", uchetiv "vayhi lishlomo arbaat alafim urvot susim". ha ketzad? im arbaim elef itztavlaot hayu, kol echad veechad hayu bo arbaat alafim urvot susim. veim arbaat alafim itztavlaot hayu, kol echad veechad hayu bo arbaim elef urvot susim.

Rabbi yitzchak rame: ketiv "en kesef nechshav bime shelomo limuma", uchetiv "vayyitten shelomo et hakkesef birushalaym kaavanim"? la kashya: kan – kodem shennasa shelomo et bat paro, kan – leachar shennasa shelomo et bat paro.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: beshaa shennasa shelomo et bat paro, yarad gavriel venaatz kane bayyam, veheela sirton, vealav nivna kerach gadol shebberomi.

Veamar rabbi yitzchak: mippene ma lo nitgallu taame tora? shehare shete mikraot nitgallu taman, venichshal bahen gedol haolam. ketiv: "lo yarbe lo nashim". amar shelomo: "ani arbe velo asur". uchetiv: "vayhi leet ziknat shelomo nashav hittu et levavo".
Uchetiv: "lo yarbe lo susim", veamar shelomo: "ani arbe velo ashiv". uchetiv: "vattetze merkava mimmitzrayim beshesh vegomer".
Vechotev sefer tora lishmo. tena: uvilvad shello yitnae beshel avotav.

Amar rava: af al pi shehinnichu lo avotav leadam sefer tora, mitzva lichtov mishshello, shenneemar: "veatta kitvu lachem et hashshira". etiveh abbaye: vechotev lo sefer tora lishmo, shello yitnae beshel acherim. melech – in, hedyot – lo!
La, tzericha lishte torot, vechidtanya: "vechatav lo et mishne vegomer" – kotev lishmo shete torot: achat shehi yotza venichneset immo, veachat shemmunnachat lo bevet genazav.

Otah sheyyotza venichneset immo, ose otah kemin kamea vetolah bizroo, shenneemar: "shivviti Adonai lenegdi tamid ki mimini bal emmot". eno nichnas bah lo levet hammerchatz velo levet hakkisse, shenneemar: "vehayta immo vekara vo" – makom harauy likrot bo.

Amar mar zutera, veittema mar ukeva: battechilla nittena tora leyisrael bichtav ivri uleshon hakkodesh. chazra venittena lahem bime ezra bichtav ashshuri uleshon arammi. berru lahen yisrael ketav ashshuri uleshon hakkodesh, vehinnichu lahedyotot ketav ivrit uleshon arammi.
Man hedyotot? amar rav chisda: kutae. may ketav ivrit? amar rav chisda: ketav libbonaa.

Tanya, rabbi yose omer: rauy haya ezra shettinnaten tora al yado leyisrael, ilmale lo kedamo moshe. bemoshe hu omer: "umoshe ala el haelohim", beezra hu omer: "hu ezra ala mibbavel". ma aliyyay haamura kan – tora, af aliyyay haamura lehallan – tora.

Bemoshe hu omer: "veoti tzivva Adonai baet hahi lelammed etchem chukkim umishpatim". beezra hu omer: "ki ezra hechin levavo lidrosh et torat Adonai elohav velaasot ulelammed beyisrael chok umishpat". veaf al pi shello nittena tora al yado, nishtanna al yado hakketav, shenneemar:

a: "Uchetav hannishtevan katuv aramit umeturgam arammit". uchetiv: "la chahalin ketava lemikre ufishre lehodaa lemalka". [melammed shebbeoto hayyom nittan] uchetiv: "vechatav et mishne hattora hazzot" – ketav harauy lehishtannot.
Lamma nikra shemo ashshuri? sheala immahem meashshur.

Tanya, rabbi omer: battechilla bichtav ze nittena tora leyisrael. kevan shechatu, nehpach lahen leroetz. kevan shechazru bahen, hechziro lahem, shenneemar: "shuvu levitztzaron asire hattikva gam hayyom maggid mishne ashiv lach".
Lamma nikra shemo ashshuri? shemmeushshar bichtavo‍.

Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi eliezer ben parta, sheamar mishshum rabbi elazar hammodai: ketav ze lo nishtanna kol ikkar, shenneemar: "vave haammudim". ma ammudim lo nishtannu, af vavim lo nishtannu. veomer: "veel hayyehudim kichtavam vechilshonam" – ma leshonam lo nishtanna, af ketavam lo nishtanna.

Ella ma ani mekayyem "et mishne hattora hazzot"? lishte torot: achat sheyyotza venichneset immo, veachat shemmunnachat lo bevet genazav. otah sheyyotza venichneset immo – ose otah kemin kamea vetolah bizroo, shenneemar: "shivviti Adonai lenegdi tamid".

Veiddach, hay "shivviti" may daresh beh? hahu mibbee leh kidrav chana bar bizna, deamar rav chana bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida: hammitpallel tzarich sheyyire atzmo keillu shechina kenegdo, shenneemar: "shivviti Adonai lenegdi tamid".
Lerabbi shimon, deamar: "ketav ze lo nishtanna", may "la chahalin ketava lemikre"? amar rav: begimatriyya ikketiv lehon "ytet ytet adech pavegachemat".
May paresh lehu? "mene mene tekel ufarsin". "mene" – mena elaha malchutach vehashelma lach. "tekel" – tekilta vemozanya vehishtechachat chassir. "parsin" – perisat malchutach vihivat lemaday ufaras.
Ushemuel amar: "mametaves nanekapey aalaren". verabbi yochanan amar: "anem anem lakat naysarepav". rav ashe amar: "namea namea katel porsin".

Mishna en rochvin al suso, veen yoshvin al kiso, veen mishtammeshin besharvito, veen roin oto keshehu mistapper, velo keshehu arom, velo keshehu bevet hammerchatz, shenneemar: "som tasim alecha melech", shettehe emato alecha.

Gemara amar rav yaakov amar rabbi yochanan: avishag mutteret lishlomo, vaasura laadoniyya. mutteret lishlomo – demelech haya, umelech mishtammesh besharvito shel melech. vaasura laadoniyya – dehedyot hu.

Avishag may hi? dichtiv: "vehammelech david zaken ba bayyamim vegomer vayyomru lo avadav yevakshu vegomer", uchetiv: "vayvakshu naara yafa vegomer", uchetiv: "vehannaara yafa ad meod vattehi lammelech sochenet vatteshartehu". amara: "ninsevan!" amar la: "asirat li".

Amara leh: chassereh legannava, nafsheh beshalmana naket. amar lehu: kiru li levat sheva. uchetiv: "vattavo vat sheva el hammelech hachadra". amar rav yehuda amar rav: beotah shaa kinnecha bat sheva bishlosh esre mappot.
Amar rav shemen bar abba: bo uree kamma kashin gerushin, shehare david hammelech hittiru lo leyayched, velo hittiru lo legaresh.

Amar rabbi eliezer: kol hamegaresh et ishto rishona, afillu mizbeach morid alav demaot, shenneemar: "vezot shenit taasu kassot dima et mizbach Adonai bechi vaanaka meen od penot el hammincha velakachat ratzon miyyedchem", uchetiv: "vaamartem al ma al ki Adonai heid bencha uven eshet neurecha asher atta bagadta bah vehi chavertecha veeshet beritecha".
Amar rabbi yochanan, veittema rabbi elazar: en ishto shel adam meta ella im ken mevakkeshin mimmennu mamon veen lo, shenneemar: "veim en lecha leshallem lamma yikkach mishkavcha mittachtecha".

Veamar rabbi yochanan: kol adam shemmeta ishto rishona, keillu charav bet hammikdash beyamav, shenneemar: "ben adam hinni lokeach mimmecha et machmad enecha bemaggefa lo tispod velo tivke velo tavo dimatecha". uchetiv: "vaadabber el haam babboker vattamot ishti baarev". uchetiv: "hinni mechallel et mikdashi geon uzzechem machmad enechem".

Amar rabbi alekkesanderi: kol adam shemmeta ishto beyamav, olam chashach baado, shenneemar: "or chashach beoholo venero alav yidach". rabbi yose bar chanina amar: pesiotav mitkatztzerot, shenneemar: "yetzru tzaade ono". rabbi avahu amar: atzato nofelet, shenneemar: "vetashlichehu atzato".

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kashe lezavvevgam kikriat yam suf, shenneemar: "elohim moshiv yechidim bayta motzi asirim bakkosharot". al tikre "motzi asirim" ella "kemotzi asirim", al tikre "bakkosharot" ella "bechi veshirot".
Ini? vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav: arbaim yom kodem yetzirat havvalad, bat kol yotzet veomeret "bat peloni lifloni"! la kashya: ha beziuug rishon, ha beziuug sheni.

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachman: lakkol yesh temura, chutz meeshet neurim, shenneemar: "veeshet neurim ki timmaes". matne la rav yehuda lerav yitzchak bereh: en adam motze korat ruach ella meishto rishona, shenneemar: "yehi mekorcha varuch usemach meeshet
b: Neurecha". amar lo: kegon man? amar lo: kegon immach.

Ini? veha makre leh rav yehuda lerav yitzchak bereh: "umotze ani mar mimmavet et haishsha asher hi metzodim vacharamim". veamar lo: kegon man? veamar lo: kegon immach. mitkaf takkifa, aybore meabbera bemilla.
Amar rav shemuel bar uneya mishshemeh derav: ishsha golem hi, veenah koretet berit ella lemi sheasaah keli, shenneemar: "ki voalayich osayich Adonai tzevaot shemo".

Tana: en ish met ella leishto, veen ishsha meta ella levalah. en ish met ella leishto, shenneemar: "vayyamat elimelech ish noomi". veen ishsha meta ella levalah, shenneemar: "vaani bevoi mippaddan meta alay rachel".
En roin oto kulei. tanu rabbanan: melech mistapper bechol yom, kohen gadol meerev shabbat leerev shabbat, kohen hedyot echad lishloshim yom.
Melech mistapper bechol yom, shenneemar: "melech beyofyo techezena enecha". kohen gadol meerev shabbat, amar rav shemuel bar nachman amar rabbi yochanan: hoil umishmarot mitchaddeshot.

Kohen hedyot echad lishloshim yom, dichtiv: "verosham lo yegallechu ufera lo yeshallechu kasom yichsemu et rashehem", veyalef pera pera minnazir. ketiv hacha: "pera lo yeshallechu", uchetiv hatam: "gaddel pera sear rosho". ma lehallan sheloshim, af kan sheloshim. utenan name: setam nezirut sheloshim yom.
Vehatam mena lan? amar rav matna: deamar kera "kadosh yihye", begimatriyya telatin havu.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: ema la lirabbo kelal! amar leh: i ketiv "lo yeshallechu pera" – kidkaamrat, hasheta dichtiv "ufera [lo yeshallechu]" – pera leheve, shalloche la lishallechu.
I hachi, haiddana name? dumeya deyayin: ma yayin, bizman bia hu deasur, shello bizman bia shere – af perue rosh, bizman bia asur, shello bizman bia shere.

Veyayin shello bizman bia shere? vehatanya: rabbi omer, omer ani: kohanim asurin lishtot yayin leolam, aval ma eese shettakkanato kalkalato. veamar abbaye: keman shatu kahane chamra haiddana? kerabbi. mikkelal derabbanan asri.
Hatam hayeynu tama, mehera yibbane bet hammikdash, uvaenan kohen harauy laavoda, velekka. hacha name, baena kohen harauy laavoda, velekka.

Hacha efshar dimsappar veayel. hatam name efshar denayem pureta veayel, deamar rav acha: derech mil veshena kol shehu mefigin et hayyayin. velav ittemar ala: amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: lo shanu ella sheshshata kede reviit, aval yoter mikkede reviit – kol shekken dederech toradto veshena meshakkarto.
Rav ashe amar: shetuye yayin demachali avoda – gezaru behu rabbanan, perue rosh dela machali avoda – la gezaru behu rabbanan.
Metivi: veellu shebbemita – perue rosh ushetuye yayin.
Bishlama shetuye yayin, dichtiv: "yayin veshechar al tesht atta uvanecha... velo tamutu". ella perue rosh, mena lan?
Deittakkash shetuye yayin lifrue rosh, ketiv: "verosham lo yegallechu ufera lo yeshallechu", uchetiv: "veyayin lo yishtu vegomer". ma shetuye yayin bemita, af perue rosh bemita.
Uminna: ma shetuye yayin demachali avoda – af perue rosh demachali avoda. kashya!

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: hay, ad dela ata yechezkel, man amra? velitamaych, ha deamar rav chisda: davar ze mittorat moshe rabbenu lo lamadnu, ad shebba yechezkel velimmedanu: "kol ben nechar erel lev veerel basar lo yavo el mikdashi lesharteni", ad delo ba yechezkel man amra? ella, gemara gemiri la, vaata yechezkel veasmecha akkera. hacha name, gemara gemiri la, vaata yechezkel veasmecha akkera.
Vechi gamri halacha lemita, leachole avoda la gemiri.

May "kasom yichsemu et rashehem"? tana: kemin tisporet luleyaynit. may tisporet luleyaynit? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: tispureta yechidaa. hechi dame? amar rav ashe: rosho shel ze betzad ikkaro shel ze.

Shaalu et rabbi: ezehu tisporet shel kohen gadol? amar lahen: tzeu ureu mittisporet shel ben elasa. tanya, rabbi omer: lo al chinnam pizzer ben elasa et meotav, ella kede lehareot bo tisporet shel kohen gadol.
Hadaran alach kohen gadol.

a: Mishna dine mamonot bishlosha. ze borer lo echad, veze borer lo echad, ushenehen borrin lahen od echad, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: shene dayyaynin borrin lahen od echad.

Ze posel dayyayno shel ze, veze posel dayyayno shel ze – divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: ematay? bizman shemmevi alehen reaya shehen kerovin o pesulin. aval im hayu kesherin o mumechin mippi bet din – eno yachol lefoslan.
Ze posel edav shel ze, veze posel edav shel ze. divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: ematay? bizman shemmevi alehen reaya shehen kerovin o pesulin, aval im hayu kesherin – eno yachol lefoslan.
Gemara may "ze borer lo echad veze borer lo echad"? bitlata saggi!
Hachi kaamar: keshezze borer lo bet din echad, veze borer lo bet din echad, shenehen borrin lahen od echad.
Vaafillu love matze meakkev? vehaamar rabbi elazar: lo shanu ella malve, aval love kofin oto vedan beiro.
Kidamar rabbi yochanan: bearkaot shebbesureya shanu. hacha name, bearkaot shebbesureya shanu. aval mumechin – la.
Rav pappa amar: afillu tema mumechin, kegon be dina derav huna uderav chisda, dekaamar leh: mi ka matrachna lach?
Tenan: vachachamim omrim, shene dayyaynin borrin lahen od echad. vei salka datach kidkaamrinan bet din – bet din batar defasli lehu, azlu uvarru lehu be dina acharine?
Veod, may "ze borer lo echad veze borer lo echad"?
Ella hachi kaamar: keshezze borer lo dayyayn echad, veze borer lo dayyayn echad, shenehen borrin lahen od echad.
May shena deavdi hachi? amri bemareva mishshemeh derabbi zera: mittoch shezze borer lo dayyayn echad, veze borer lo dayyayn echad, ushenehen borrin lahen od echad – yetze haddin laamitto.
Vachachamim omrim kulei. nema bidrav yehuda amar rav kamippalgi?
Deamar rav yehuda amar rav: en haedim chotmin al hashshetar ella im ken yodin mi chotem immahen. rabbi meir let leh derav yehuda amar rav, verabbanan it lehu derav yehuda amar rav.

La, dechulle alma it lehu derav yehuda amar rav, vedaat haddayyaynin – kulle alma la peligi devaenan. ki peligi – daat baale dinin: rabbi meir savar daat baale dinin name baenan, verabbanan savri daat haddayyaynin baenan, daat baale dinin la baenan.

Gufa, amar rav yehuda amar rav: en haedim chotmin al hashshetar kulei. tanya name hachi: kach hayu nekiyye haddaat shebbirushalayim osin – lo hayu chotmin al hashshetar ella im ken yodin mi chotem immahen, velo hayu yoshvin bedin ella im ken yodin mi yoshev immahen, velo hayu nichnasin bisuda ella im ken yodin mi mesev immahen.
Ze posel dayyayno kulei. kol keminneh defasel dayyayne?
Amar rabbi yochanan: bearkaot shebbesureya shanu, aval mumechim – lo.

Ha middekatane sefa: vachachamim omrim, ematay? bizman shemmevi reaya shehen kerovin o pesulin. aval im hayu kesherin, o mumechin mippi bet din – eno yachol lefoslan, mikkelal derabbi meir mumechin name kaamar!
Hachi kaamar: aval im hayu kesherin, naasu kemumechin mippi bet din, veeno yachol lefoslan.
Ta shema: amru lo lerabbi meir, lo kol hemennu shepposel dayyayn shemmumeche lerabbim.
Ema: lo kol hemennu shepposel dayyayn shehimchuhu rabbim alehem.
Tanya name hachi: leolam posel veholech, ad sheyyekabbel alav bet din shemmumeche lerabbim. divre rabbi meir.
Veha edim kemumechin dame? veamar rabbi meir: ze posel edav shel ze, veze posel edav shel ze.
Ha ittemar ala, amar resh lakish: pe kadosh yomar davar ze? teni: "edo".
Edo lemay? ilema lemamon, rachamana pasleh! i lishvua, hemone meheman keve tere!
Leolam lemamon. la tzericha, dekabbeleh aleh keve tere.

May ka mashma lan: dematze hadar beh? tenena: amar lo "neeman alay abba", "neeman alay avicha", "neemanin alay shelosha roe bakar" – rabbi meir omer: yachol lachazor bo, vachachamim omrim: eno yachol lachazor bo.
b: Veamar rav dimi bereh derav nachman bereh derav yosef: kegon dekabbeleh aleh bechad.
Tzericha, dei tena "abba" veavich" – beha kaamri rabbanan dela matze hadar beh, mishshum deabba veavich chazu lealma. aval chad keve tere, dilalma la chaze – ema: modu leh lerabbi meir.
Vei ashmeinan beha, beha kaamar rabbi meir, aval behahi – ema modu lehu lerabbanan. tzericha.
Ha middekatane resha "dayyayno", vesefa "edav" – alma davka katane.
Amar rabbi elazar: beva hu veacher lefoslan.
Kol keminneh? nogea beeduto hu!
Amar rav acha bereh derav ika: kegon shekkara alav arar.
Arar demay? illema arar degazlanuta, kol keminneh? nogea beeduto hu!
Ella: arar difgam mishpacha. rabbi meir savar: hane ammishpacha kamashadi, veihu mimmela kafasel. verabbanan savri: sof sof nogea beeduto hu.
Ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi yochanan: machaloket bishte kitte edim.
Derabbi meir savar: tzarich levarer, verabbanan savri: eno tzarich levarer. aval bechat achat – divre hakkol en yachol lefoslan.
Amru lefanav rav amme verav assi: en sham ella kat achat, mahu?
En sham ella kat achat? vehaamrat: aval bechat achat divre hakkol en yachol lefoslan! ella, nimtzet kat sheniyya kerovin o fesulin – mahu?
Amar lahen: kevar heidu edim harishonim. ikka deamri, amar rav ashe: kevar heidu edim harishonim.
Nema, biflugeta derabbi verabban shimon ben gamliel kamippalgi?
Detanya: habba liddon bishtar uvachazaka, niddon bishtar – divre rabbi. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: niddon bachazaka.
Vehavenan ba: bachazaka velo bishtar? ella ema: af bachazaka.
Vekayyma lan, divtzarich levarer peligi.
La. allibba derabban shimon ben gamliel, kulle alma la peligi. ki peligi, allibba derabbi. derabbi meir kerabbi.
Verabbanan amri lach: ad kan la kaamar rabbi hatam ella bachazaka, demikkoach shetara kaate. aval hacha, dehane edim lav mikkoach edim acharine kaatu, afillu rabbi mode deen tzarich levarer.
Ki ata ravin, amar rabbi yochanan: resha

a: Beedim pesulin vedayyaynin kesherin, miggo defasli ede – pasli name dayyayne. sefa: bedayyaynin pesulin veedim kesherin, demiggo defasli dayyayne – pasli name ede.
Matkef la rava: bishlama, miggo defasli ede pasli name dayyayne, ikka be dina acharina. ella miggo defasli dayyayne pasli name ede? veha edim tu lekka!
La tzericha, deikka kat acheret.
Ha lekka kat acheret, may? hachi name dela matze pasli? hayeynu derav dimi!
Ikka benayyhu miggo, demar savar: amrinan miggo, umar savar: la amrinan miggo.
Gufa, amar resh lakish: pe kadosh yomar davar ze? teni: "edo".
Ini? vehaamar ulla: haroe et resh lakish bevet hammidrash, keillu oker harim vetochanan ze baze.
Amar ravina: vahalo kol haroe rabbi meir bevet hammidrash, keillu oker hare harim vetochanan ze baze!
Hachi kaamar: ba uree kamma mechabbevin ze et ze.
Ki ha deyatev rabbi vekaamar: asur lehatemin et hatztzonen. amar lefanav rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: abba hittir lehatemin et hatztzonen. amar lahem: kevar hora zaken.

Amar rav pappa: bo uree kamma mechabbevin ze et ze, deillu rabbi yose kayyaym haya, kafuf veyoshev lifne rabbi. deha rabbi yishmael berabbi yose memalle mekom avotav hava, vehaya kafuf veyoshev lifne rabbi, veka amar: kevar hora zaken.

Amar rabbi oshaya: may dichtiv "vaekkach li et shene maklot leachad karati noam uleachad karati chovlim"? "noam" – ellu talmide chachamim shebbeeretz yisrael, shemmanimin ze laze bahalacha. "chovlim" – ellu talmide chachamim shebbevavel, shemmechabbelim ze laze bahalacha.

"Vayyomer elay elle [shene] vene hayyitzhar haomdim vegomer ushenayim zetim aleha". "yitzhar" – amar rabbi yitzchak: ellu talmide chachamim shebbeeretz yisrael, shennochin ze laze bahalacha keshemen zayit. "ushenayim zetim aleha" – ellu talmide chachamim shebbevavel, shemmerorin ze laze bahalacha kezayit.

"Vaessa enay vaere vehinne shetayim nashim yotzot veruach bechanfehem velahenna chenafayim kechanfe hachasida vattissena haefa ben hashshamayim uven haaretz. vaomar el hammalach haddover bi ana hemma molichot et haefa. vayyomer elay livnot la vayit beeretz shinar". amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: zo chanuppa vegassut haruach sheyyardu levavel.
