Vegassut haruach levavel nechit? vehaamar mar: asara kabbin gassut yardu leolam, tisha natla elam veachat kol haolam kullo!
In, levavel nechit, veishtarbove [hu] deishtarbav leelam. dayka name, dichtiv: "livnot la vayit beeretz shinar". shema minna.

Vehaamar mar: siman legassut haruach – aniyyut, vaaniyyut levavel nechit! may aniyyut? aniyyut tora, dichtiv: "achot lanu ketanna veshadayim en lah". amar rabbi yochanan: zo elam, shezzachta lilmod velo zachta lelammed.
May bavel? amar rabbi yochanan: belula bammikra, belula bammishna, belula battalmud. "bemachashakkim hoshivani kemete olam" – amar rabbi yirmeya: ze talmudah shel bavel.
Mishna amar lo: "neeman alay abba", "neeman alay avicha", "neemanim alay shelosha roe bakar". rabbi meir omer: yachol lachzor bo, vachachamim omrim: eno yachol lachzor bo.
Haya chayyayv lachavero shevua, veamar lo: "dor li bechayye roshecha". rabbi meir omer: yachol lachzor bo, vachachamim omrim: en yachol lachzor bo.
Gemara amar rav dimi bereh derav nachman bereh derav yosef: kegon dekabbeleh aleh bechad.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: machloket bemachul lach", aval beetten lach" – divre hakkol yachol lachzor bo. verabbi yochanan amar: beetten lach" – machloket.
Ibbaya lehu: beetten lach" – machloket, aval bemachul lach" – divre hakkol en yachol lachzor bo? o dilma: ben bazo uven bazo machloket?
Ta shema, deamar rava: machloket beetten lach", aval bemachul lach" – divre hakkol en yachol lachzor bo.
I amrat bishlama beetten lach" – machloket, aval bemachul lach" – divre hakkol en yachol lachzor bo, rava deamar kerabbi yochanan. ella i amrat ben bazo uven bazo machloket, rava deamar keman?
Rava tama denafsheh kaamar.
Etiveh rav acha bar tachlifa lerava: haya chayyayv lachavero shevua, veamar lo: "dor li bechayye roshecha". rabbi meir omer: yachol lachzor bo, vachachamim omrim: en yachol lachzor bo.
b: May lav beotan hannishbain velo meshallemin, dahava leh kemachul lach"?
La, beotan hannishbain venotlin, dehave leh keetten lach".
Veha tena leh resha!
Tena tole bedaat acherim, utena tole bedaat atzmo.
Utzericha, dei tena tole bedaat acherim – beha kaamar rabbi meir dematze hadar beh, mishshum dela gamar umakne, deamar: "mi yemar dimzakke leh?" aval tole bedaat atzmo, ema mode lehu lerabbanan.
Vei ashmeinan beha, beha kaamri rabbanan, aval behahi ema modu leh rabbanan lerabbi meir. tzericha.
Amar resh lakish: machloket lifne gemar din, aval leachar gemar din – divre hakkol en yachol lachzor bo. verabbi yochanan amar: leachar gemar din machloket.
Ibbaya lehu: leachar gemar din machloket, aval lifne gemar din divre hakkol yachol lachzor bo? o dilma: ben bazo uven bazo machloket?
Ta shema, deamar rava: kibbel alav karov o pasul – lifne gemar din yachol lachzor bo, leachar gemar din en yachol lachzor bo.

I amrat bishlama: leachar gemar din machloket, aval lifne gemar din divre hakkol yachol lachzor bo – rava deamar kerabbi yochanan veallibba derabbanan. ella i amrat: ben bazo ben bazo machloket – rava deamar keman?
Ella, lav shema minna: leachar gemar din machloket? shema minna.

Shelach leh rav nachman bar rav chisda lerav nachman bar yaakov: yelammedenu rabbenu, lifne gemar din machloket o leachar gemar din machloket? vahalacha kedivre mi? shelach leh: leachar gemar din machloket, vahalacha kedivre chachamim.
Rav ashe amar: hachi shelach leh, beetten lach" machloket, o bemachul lach" machloket? vahalacha kedivre mi? shelach leh: beetten lach" machloket, vahalacha kedivre chachamim.

Besura matnu hachi. befumebdita matnu hachi, amar rav chanina bar shelemya: shelachu leh mibbe rav lishmuel, yelammedenu rabbenu: lifne gemar din vekanu miyyado, may? shelach lehu: en leachar kinyayn kelum.
Mishna veellu hen happesulin: hamesachek bekuveya, vehammalve beribbit, umafriche yonim, vesochare sheviit.
Amar rabbi shimon: battechilla hayu korin otan osfe sheviit. mishsherabbu haannasin, chazru likrotan sochare sheviit.
Amar rabbi yehuda: ematay? bizman sheen lahen ummanut ella hu, aval yesh lahen ummanut shello hu – kesherin.
Gemara mesachek bekuveya, may ka aved? amar rame bar chama: mishshum dehave asmachta, veasmachta la kanya.
Rav sheshet amar: kol ki hay gavvna lav asmachta hi, ella lefi sheen asukin beyishshuvo shel olam.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu digmar ummanuta achariti.

Utenan, amar rabbi yehuda: ematay? bizman sheen lahen ummanut ella hu; aval yesh lahen ummanut shello hu – hare ze kesherim. alma, tama dematnitin mishshum yishshuvo shel olam hu. kashya lerame bar chama!
Vechi tema: peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi yehuda? veha amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol makom sheamar rabbi yehuda

a: "Ematay" uvamme" eno ella lefaresh divre chachamim.
Rabbi yochanan amar: "ematay" – lefaresh, uvamme" – lachlok. udechulle alma "ematay" lefaresh hu.
Gavra aggavra ka ramet? mar savar: peligi, umar savar: la peligi.
Vela peligi? vehatanya: ben sheyyesh lo ummanut shello hu, ben sheen lo ummanut ella hu – hare ze pasul.
Hahi rabbi yehuda mishshum rabbi tarfon hi, detanya: rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi tarfon, leolam en echad mehen nazir, lefi shello nittena nezirut ella lehafelaa.
Malve beribbit. amar rava: lava beribbit – pasul leedut. vehaanan tenan: malve beribbit? milva habbaa beribbit.
Bar binittos ashidu beh tere sahade. chad amar: kamme didi ozef beribbita, vechad amar: ledidi ozfan beribbita. pasleh rava levar binittos.
Veha rava hu deamar: lava beribbit pasul leedut, vehave leh rasha, vehattora amra: "al tashet rasha ed".
Rava letameh, deamar rava: adam karov etzel atzmo, veen adam mesim atzmo rasha.
Hahu tabbacha deishtechach dinfaka terefta mittute yedeh, pasleh rav nachman veabbereh. azal rabbi mazye vetufereh. sevar rav nachman leachshoreh.
Amar leh rava: dilma iarome ka maarem?

Ella may takkanteh? kidrav idi bar avin, deamar rav idi bar avin: hechashud al hatterefot en lo takkana ad sheyyelech lemakom sheen makkirin oto veyachzir aveda bedavar chashuv, o sheyyotzi terefa mittachat yado bedavar chashuv mishshello.
Umafriche yonim, may mafriche yonim? hacha targimu: "i tikdemeh yonach leyon". rabbi chama bar oshaya amar: "ara".
Man deamar: "i tikdemeh yonach leyon", may tama la amar "ara"?
Amar lach: "ara" – mippene darche shalom bealma.
Uman deamar "ara", may tama la amar: "i tikdemeh yonach leyon"? amar lach: hayeynu mesachek bekuveya.
Veiddach?
Tena tole bedaat atzmo, utena tole bedaat yono.
Utzericha, dei tena tole bedaat atzmo – hatam hu dela gamar umakne, deamar:
b: Kim li benafshay deyadana tefe. aval tole bedaat yono – ema la.
Vei tena tole bedaat yono, deamar: benakkasha talya milleta, vaana yadana lenakkoshe tefe. aval tole bedaat atzmo – ema la. tzericha.
Metivi: hamesachek bekuveya – ellu hen hamesachakim bifsefasim. velo bifsefasim bilvad amru, ella afillu kelippe egozim ukelippe rimmonim.
Veematay chazaratan? mishsheyyeshabberu et pesefasehen veyachzeru bahen chazara gemura, daafillu bechinnam la avdi.
Malve beribbit: echad hammalve veechad hallove. veematay chazaratan? mishsheyyekaru et shetarehen, veyachzeru bahen chazara gemura, daafillu legoy la mozfi.

Umafriche yonim – ellu shemmamrin et hayyonim. velo yonim bilvad amru, ella afillu behema chayya vaof. veematay chazaratan? mishsheyyeshabberu et pegamehen, veyachzeru bahen chazara gemura, daafillu bammidbar name la avdi.
Sochare sheviit – ellu shennosin venotnin beferot sheviit. veematay chazaratan? mishshettaggia sheviit acheret veyibbadlu.
Veamar rabbi nechemya: lo chazarat devarim bilvad amru, ella chazarat mamon. ketzad? omer: ani peloni bar peloni, kinnasti matayim zuz beferot sheviit, vahare hen netunin bemattana laaniyyim.
Katane mihat: behema. bishlama leman deamar "i tikdemeh yonach leyon", hayeynu demashkachat la behema. ella leman deamar "ara", behema bat hachi hi?
In, beshor habbar, ucheman deamar shor habbar min behema hu, ditnan: shor habbar min behema hu. rabbi yose omer: min chayya.
Tana: hosifu alehen haggazlanin vehachamsanin.
Gazlan? deorayyta hu! lo nitzrecha ella limtziat cheresh, shote, vekatan.
Meikkara sevur: metziat cheresh, shote, vekatan la shechicha. i name, mippene darche shalom bealma. kevan dachazo desof sof mamona hu deka shakli, paslinhu rabbanan.
Hachamsanin, meikkara sevur deme ka yahev (akray bealma hu). kevan dachazo deka chatfi, gezaru behu rabbanan.
Tana: od hosifu alehen haroim, haggabbain, vehammochsin.

Roim, meikkara sevur akray bealma hu. kevan dachazo deka mechavvevni veshadu lechattechilla, gezaru behu rabbanan. haggabbain vehammochsin, meikkara sevur may dekitz lehu ka shakli. kevan dachazo deka shakli yattira, paslinhu.
Amar rava: roe sheamru, echad roe behema dakka veechad roe behema gassa.
Umi amar rava hachi? vehaamar rava: roe behema dakka beeretz yisrael – pesulin, bechutza laaretz – kesherin. roe behema gassa, afillu beeretz yisrael – kesherin. hahu bimgaddelim ittemar.
Hachi name mistabbera, middekatane: neemanin alay shelosha roe vakar. may lav, leedut?
La, ledina. dayka name, dekatane: shelosha roe vakar. vei leedut, shelosha lema li?
Veella may, ledina? may irya shelosha roe vakar? kol be telata dela gemiri dina name!
Hachi kaamar: afillu hane dela shechichi bayyishshuv.
Amar rav yehuda: setam roe – pasul, setam gabbay – kasher.

Avu derabbi zera avad gavyuta telesar shenin. ki hava ate resh nahara lemata, ki hava chaze rabbanan amar lehu: "lech ammi bo vachadarecha". ki hava chaze inashe demata amar: resh nahara ata lemata, vehaiddana naches abba lefum bera uvera lefum abba,

a: Umigganzu kulle alma. ki ate, amar leh: mimman nive?
Ki nicha nafsheh, amar lehu: shekulu telesar mae detzayyri li bisdinay, veahdaru leh liflanya, dishkaltinhu minneh vela itzterichu li.
Amar rabbi shimon: battechilla hayu korin otan "osfe sheviit".
May kaamar? amar rav yehuda: hachi kaamar, battechilla hayu omrim: osfe sheviit – kesherin, socharin – pesulin.
Mishsherabbu mamtzie maot laaniyyim, veazli aniyyim veasfi lehu umayytu, chazru lomar: echad ze veechad ze pesulin.
Kashu bah bene rachava: hay "mishsherabbu haannasim"? "mishsherabbu hattaggarin" mibbee leh!

Ella, battechilla hayu omrim: echad ze veechad ze pesulin. mishsherabbu haannasin – umay ninhu? arnona – kidmachriz rabbi yannay: "puku uzerau bashsheviit mishshum arnona". chazru lomar: osfin kesherin, socharin pesulin.
Rabbi chiyyay bar zarnoke verabbi shimon ben yehotzadak havo kaazli leabber shana beasya. pega behu resh lakish, ittappal bahadayyhu. amar: ezil ichze hechi avdi ovada.
Chazyeh lehahu gavra deka charev. amar lahen: kohen vechoresh! amru lo, yachol lomar: "aggistevan ani betocho".
Tu chazyeh lehahu gavra dahava kasach becharme. amar lahen: kohen vezamar! amru lo: yachol lomar "leekel bet habbad ani tzarich". amar lahem: hallev yodea im leekel im laakalkallot.
He amar lehu beresha? ilema ha kammayyta amar lehu beresha, ha name lemru: "aggistevan ani betocho"! ella, ha amar lehu beresha, vahadar amar lehu hach.
May shena kohen? mishshum dachashidi ashsheviit.
Ditnan: sea teruma shennafla lemea sein shel sheviit – taale. pachot mikken – yerakvu.
Vehavenan ba: ammay yerakvu? yimkerennu lakkohen bidme teruma, chutz middeme otah sea.
Veamar rav chiyyay mishshemeh deulla: zot omeret, nechshedu kohanim ashsheviit.
Amru: taroda hu den. ki meto lehatam, seliku leiggara, shallefu ledarga mittuteh.
Ata lekammeh derabbi yochanan. amar leh: bene adam hachashudin al hashsheviit, kesherin leabber shana?
Hadar amar: la kashya li, midde dehave ashshelosha roe vakar, verabbanan achushebanayyhu semuch.
Vahadar amar: la dame. hatam, hadur immeno rabbanan veabberuha lehahiv shatta. hacha, kesher reshaim hu, vekesher reshaim eno min hamminyan. amar rabbi yochanan: da aka.
Ki ato lekammeh derabbi yochanan, amaru leh: kare lan "roe vakar", vela amar leh mar vela midde? amar lehu: vei kare lechu "roe tzon", may amena leh?
May kesher reshaim? shevna hava daresh bitlesar ribbevavta, chizkiyya hava daresh bechad sar ribbevavta.

Ki ata sancheriv vetzar ala dirushelem, ketav shevna pitka sheda begira: "shevna vesiato hishlimu, chizkiyya vesiato lo hishlimu". shenneemar: "ki hinne harshaim yidrechun keshet konnu chitztzam al yeter".

Hava ka mistefe chizkiyya, amar: dilma chas veshalom natya dateh dekudesha berich hu batar rubba, kevan derubba mimmasri inhu name mimmasri. ba navi veamar lo: "lo tomrun kesher lechol asher yomar haam hazze kasher", kelomar, kesher reshaim hu, vekesher reshaim eno min hamminyan.
Halach lachtzov lo kever bekivre bet david. ba navi veamar lo: "ma lecha fo umi lecha fo ki chatzavta lecha po kaver... hinne Adonai metaltelcha taltela gaver".
Amar rav: tiltula degavra kashe middeitteta.
"Veotcha ato" – amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: melammed shepparcha bo tzaraat. ketiv hacha "veotcha ato", uchetiv hatam "veal safam yate".

"Tzanof yitznofcha tzenefa kaddur el eretz rachavat yadayim vegomer". tana: hu bikkesh kelon bet adonav, lefichach nehpach kevodo lekalon. ki hava nafek ihu, ata gavriel achdeh ledashsha beappe mashreyayteh.
b: Amaru leh: mashyryaytach hecha? amar: hadaru bi. amaru leh: im ken, achoche ka machyeychat ban! nekavuhu baakavav utelauhu bezanve susehem, vehayu megarrin oto al hakkotzim veal habbarkanin.
Amar rabbi elazar: shevna baal hanaa haya. ketiv hacha: "lech bo el hassochen hazze", uchetiv hatam: "vattehi lo sochenet".

Veomer: "ki hashshatot yeharesun tzaddik ma paal". rav yehuda verav ena, chad amar: illu chizkiyya vesiato neherasim, tzaddik ma paal? vechad amar: illu bet hammikdash yahares, tzaddik ma paal? veulla amar: illu machshevotav shel oto rasha enan neherasot, tzaddik ma paal?
Bishlama leman deamar: illu machshevotav shel oto rasha, hayeynu dichtiv "ki hashshatot yeharesun".
Uleman deamar bet hammikdash, name – ditnan: even hayta sham mimot neviim harishonim, ushetiyyay hayta nikret.
Ella leman deamar chizkiyya vesiato, hecha ashkechan tzaddike deikkeru "shatot"?
Dichtiv: "ki laAdonai metzuke eretz vayyashet alehem tevel". veibbaet ema mehacha: "hifli etza higdil tushiyya".

Amar rabbi chanan: lamma nikra shemah tushiyya? mippene shehi matteshet kocho shel adam. davar acher: tushiyya – shennittena bachashay mippene hassatan. davar acher: tushiyya – devarim shel tohu shehaolam meshuttat alehem.
Amar ulla: machshava moelet afillu ledivre tora, shenneemar: "mefer machshevot arumim velo taasena yedehem tushiyya".
Amar rabba: im asukin lishmah, enah moelet, shenneemar: "rabbot machashavot belev ish vaatzat Adonai hi takum". etza sheyyesh bah devar Adonai hi takum leolam.
Amar rabbi yehuda ematay. amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar: halacha kerabbi yehuda.
Veamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar: kullan tzerichin hacheraza bevet din.
Roe – peligi ba rav acha veravina: chad amar bae hacheraza, vechad amar la bae hacheraza.
Bishlama leman deamar la bae hacheraza, hayeynu deamar rav yehuda amar rav: setam roe pasul. ella leman deamar bae hacheraza, may setam roe pasul?
Devistama machrezinan aleh.
Hahi mattana dahavo chatimi ala teren gazlanin, sevar rav pappa bar shemuel leachshora, deha la achrezinan alayyhu.
Amar leh rava: nehi devaenan hacheraza begazlan derabbanan, begazlan deorayyta mi baenan hacheraza?
Siman: davar, vaarayot, gannav.
Amar rav nachman: ochle davar acher pesulin leedut.
Hane mille befarhesya, aval betzina la. uvefarhesya name la amaran ella deefshar leh leittezone betzina, veka mevazze nafsheh befarhesya. aval la efshar leh – chayyuteh hu.
Amar rav nachman: hechashud al haarayot kasher leedut. amar rav sheshet: ani mari, arbein bechatpeh vechasher?
Amar rava: umode rav nachman leinyan edut ishsha shehu pasul. amar ravina, veittema rav pappa: la amaran ella leappoka, aval leayyola – let lan ba.
Peshita! mahu detema ha adifa leh, dichtiv: "mayim genuvim yimtaku vegomer"? ka mashma lan dechamma dekayyma hachi shechicha leh.
Veamar rav nachman: gannav nisan vegannav tishre – la shemeh gannav.
Vehane mille baarisa, vedavar muat, uvedavar shennigmera melachto.
Ikkareh derav zevid, chad genav kabba disare, ufasleh, vechad genav kibbura daahine, ufasleh.
Hanhu kavorae dikvur nafsha beyom tov rishon shel atzeret, shammetinhu rav pappa ufaslinhu leedut, veachsherinhu rav huna bereh derav yehoshua.
Amar leh rav pappa: veha reshaim ninhu? savri: mitzva ka avdi.
Veha ka meshammetinan lehu? savri: kappara ka avdi lan rabbanan.
Ittemar:

a: Ed zomem, abbaye amar: lemafrea hu nifsal; verava amar: mikkan ulehabba hu nifsal.
Abbaye amar: lemafrea hu nifsal, meiddana deashed rasha hu, vehattora amra: "al tashet yadcha im rasha" – al tashet rasha ed.
Rava amar: mikkan ulehabba hu nifsal. ed zomem chiddush hu, may chazet desamchat ahane? semoch ahane! en lach bo ella mishsheat chiddusho veelach.
Ikka deamri: rava name keabbayye sevira leh, umay taam kaamar mikkan ulehabba? mishshum peseda delakochot.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu deashidu be tere bechad. i name, defaslinhu begazlanuta.
Veamar rabbi yirmeya middifti: avad rav pappi ovada kevavteh derava. mar bar rav ashe amar: hilcheta kevavteh deabbaye.
Vehilcheta kevavteh deabbaye beyaal kagam".
Mumar ochel nevelot leteavon – divre hakkol pasul.
Lehacheis – abbaye amar: pasul, rava amar: kasher.
Abbaye amar: pasul, dehave leh rasha, verachamana amar "al tashet rasha ed". verava amar: kasher, rasha dechamas baenan.
Metivi: "al tashet rasha ed", "al tashet chamas ed" – ellu gazlanin umoalin bishvuot. may lav, echad shevuat shav veechad shevuat mamon?
La, idi veidi shevuat mamon. umay "shevuot"? shevuot dealma.
Metivi: "al tashet rasha ed", "al tashet chamas ed" – ellu gazlanin umalve ribbiyyot. teyuveta deabbaye, teyuveta.
Nema ketannae: ed zomem pasul lechol hattora kullah, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer: bamme devarim amurim? shehuzam bedine nefashot; aval huzam bedine mamonot – kasher ledine nefashot.
Nema: abbaye kerabbi meir, verava kerabbi yose? abbaye kerabbi meir, deamar: amrinan mikkulla lechumera. verava deamar kerabbi yose, deamar: mechumera lekulla amrinan, mikkulla lechumera la amrinan.
La. allibba derabbi yose kulle alma la feligi, ki peligi allibba derabbi meir.
Abbaye kerabbi meir, verava: ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam ella gabbe ed zomem demamon, dera lashshamayim vera labberiyyot. aval hacha, dera lashshamayim veen ra labberiyyot – la.
Vehilcheta kevavteh deabbaye. veha ittotav? hahi rabbi yose hi.
Vetihve name rabbi yose? rabbi meir verabbi yose – halacha kerabbi yose!
Shane hatam, distam lan tena kerabbi meir. vehecha setam lan?

Ki ha devar chama ketal nafsha, amar leh resh galuta lerav abba bar yaakov: pok ayyen bah, i vadday ketal – lichhayu leeneh. ato tere sahadi, ashidu beh devadday ketal. azal ihu, ayyti tere sahade, ashidu beh bechad mehanach. chad amar: kammay didi genav kabba dechushela, vechad amar: kammay didi genav
b: Katta devuretya.
Amar leh: may dataych? kerabbi meir? rabbi meir verabbi yose – halacha kerabbi yose, verabbi yose haamar: huzam bedine mamonot – kasher ledine nefashot!
Amar leh rav pappe: hane mille hecha dela setam lan tanna kerabbi meir. hacha setam lan tanna kerabbi meir.

Mimmay? illema meha ditnan: kol harauy ladun dine nefashot rauy ladun dine mamonot. manni? illema rabbi yose hi, ha ikka ed zomem demamon, dechasher ledine nefashot ufasul ledine mamonot! ella lav, rabbi meir hi.
Mimmay? dilma bifsule yuchasin kae!

Dei la tema hachi, sefa dekatane: yesh rauy ladun dine mamonot veen rauy ladun dine nefashot, ammay eno rauy? deittazzam bedine nefashot rauy ladun dine mamonot? veha divre hakkol pasul hu! ella bifsul yuchasin kae. hacha name bifsul yuchasin kae.

Ella, hacha ka satam lan tena, ditnan: ellu hen happesulim – hamesachek bekuveya, umalve beribbit, umafriche yonim, vesochare sheviit, vehaavadim. ze hakkelal: kol edut sheen haishsha keshera lah, af hen en kesherin lah.
Manni? illema rabbi yose – vehaikka edut bedine nefashot, sheen haishsha keshera lah, vehen kesherin la? ella lav rabbi meir hi!
Kam bar chama, nashshekeh akkareh, vekabbeleh lichrageh dechulle sheneh.
Mishna veellu hen hakkerovin: achiv, vaachi aviv, vaachi immo, uvaal achoto, uvaal achot aviv, uvaal achot immo, uvaal immo, vechamiv, vegiso. hen uvenehen vechatnehen, vechorgo levaddo.
Amar rabbi yose: zo mishnat rabbi akiva, aval mishna rishona – dodo uven dodo vechol harauy leyorsho, vechol hakkarov lo beotah shaa.
Haya karov venitrachek, hare ze kasher. rabbi yehuda omer: afillu meta bitto veyesh lo banim mimmenna, hare ze karov.
Haohev vehassone. ohev – ze shoshvino. sone – kol shello dibber immo shelosha yamim beeva. amru lo: lo nechshedu yisrael al kach.
Gemara menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "lo yumetu avot al banim". ma talmud lomar? im lelammed shello yumetu avot baavon banim uvanim baavon avot, hare kevar neemar: "ish becheto yumatu".
Ella, "lo yumetu avot al banim" – beedut banim, "uvanim lo yumetu al avot" – beedut avot.
Uvanim baavon avot la? vehachtiv: "poked avon avot al banim"!
Hatam, kesheochazin maase avotehen bidehen.

Kidtanya: "veaf baavonot avotam ittam yimmakku" – kesheochazin maase avotehem bidehem. atta omer kesheochazin, o eno ella kesheen ochazin? keshehu omer "ish becheto yumatu", hare kesheochazin maase avotehen bidehen.
Vela? vehachtiv: "vechashlu ish beachiv" – ish baavon achiv, melammed shekkullan arevim ze baze.
Hatam, shehaya beyadam limchot velo michu.

a: Ashkechan avot levanim, uvanim leavot.
Vechol shekken avot lahadade.
Banim levanim – menalan?
Im ken, lichtov kera: "lo yumetu avot al ben"! may "banim"? daafillu banim lahadade.
Ashkechan banim lahadade, banim lealma menalan?
Amar rame bar chama: sevara hu, kidtanya: en haedim naasin zommin ad sheyyizzommu shenehen. vei salka datach banim lealma kesherin, nimtza ed zomem neherag beedut achiv.
Amar leh rava: velitamaych, ha ditnan: shelosha achin veechad mitztaref immahen – hare ellu shalosh ediyyot, vehen edut achat lahazama.
Nimtza ed zomem meshallem mamon beedut achiv.
Ella, hazama mealma kaate. hacha name, hazama mealma kaate.
Ella, im ken lichtov kera "uven al avot", i name "hem al avot". may "uvanim"? afillu banim lealma.
Ashkechan kerove haav, kerove haem menalan? amar kera: "avot" "avot" tere zimne. im eno inyan likrove haav, tenehu inyan likrove haem.
Ashkechan lechova, lizchut mena lan?
Amar kera: "yumetu", "yumetu" – tere zimne. im eno inyan lechova, tenehu inyan lizchut.
Ashkechan bedine nefashot, bedine mamonot menalan?
Amar kera: "mishpat echad yihye lachem" – mishpat hashshave lachem.
Amar rav: achi abba lo yaid li, hu uveno vachatano. af ani lo aid lo, ani uveni vachatani.
Veammay? have leh shelishi berishon, vaanan sheni besheni tenan, shene berishon tenan, shelishi berishon la tenan!
May "chatano" dekatane bematnitin? chatan beno.
Velitne "ben beno"!
Milleta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan, devaal keishto.
Veella ha detane rabbi chiyyay: shemona avot, shehen esrim vearbaa – hane telatin vetarten have!
Ella, leolam chatano mammash. veammay kare leh "chatan beno"? kevan demealma kaate, kedor acher dame.
I hachi, have leh shelishi besheni, verav achshar shelishi besheni.
Ella rav deamar kerabbi elazar. detanya: rabbi elazar omer, keshem sheachi abba lo yaid li – hu uveno vachatano, kach ben achi abba lo yaid li – hu uveno vachatano.
Veakkatti have leh shelishi besheni, verav achshar shelishi besheni.
Rav savar leh kevavteh bachada, ufelig aleh bachada.
May tama derav? deamar kera: "lo yumetu avot al banim uvanim", lerabbot dor acher.
Verabbi elazar, "al banim" amar rachamana: pesule deavot shedi abbanim.
Amar rav nachman: achi chamoti lo yaid li, ben achi chamoti lo yaid li, ben achot chamoti lo yaid li. utena tuna: baal achoto, uvaal achot aviv, uvaal achot immo, hen uvenehen vechatnehen.
Amar rav ashe: ki havenan be ulla, ibbei lan: achi chamiv mahu? ben achi chamiv mahu? ben achot chamiv mahu?
Amar lan: tenetuha, achiv vaachi aviv vaachi immo – hen uvenehen vechatnehen.
Rav ikkela lemizban
b: Gevile. beo minneh: mahu sheyyaid adam beeshet chorgo?
Besura amri: baal keishto.

Befumebdita amri: ishsha kevalah. deamar rav huna amar rav nachman: minnayin shehaishsha kevalah? dichtiv: "ervat achi avicha lo tegalle el ishto lo tikrav dodatcha hi". vahalo eshet dodo hi! mikkelal deishsha kevalah.
Uvaal immo, hu uveno vachatano. beno – hayeynu achiv?
Amar rabbi yirmeya: lo nitzrecha ella laachi haach.
Rav chisda achshar baachi haach. amaru leh: la shemia lach ha derabbi yirmeya? amar lehu: la shemia li, kelomar, la sevira li.
I hachi, hayeynu achiv! tena achiv min haav, vekatane achiv min haem.
Amar rav chisda: avi chatan vaavi kalla meidin ze al ze, vela damu lahadade ella ki achla ledanna.
Amar rabba bar bar chana: meid adam leishto arusa. amar ravina: la amaran ella leappoke minna, aval leayyole la – la meheman.
Vela hi, la shena leappoke vela shena leayyole – la meheman.
May dataych? kidamar rabbi chiyyay bar amme mishshemeh deulla: ishto arusa lo onen velo mittamme la, vechen hi lo onenet velo mittammea lo. meta – eno yorshah, met hu – gova ketubbatah.
Hatam, bishero tela rachamana, akkatti lav sheero hi. hacha, mishshum ikkarove data hu, veha ikkarava dateh legabba.
Chorgo levaddo. tanu rabbanan: chorgo levaddo. rabbi yose omer: giso. vetanya iddach: giso levaddo. rabbi yehuda omer: chorgo.

May kaamar? illema hachi kaamar: chorgo levaddo, vehu haddin legiso. vaata rabbi yose lememar: giso levaddo, vehu haddin lechorgo. ella matnitin dekatane: giso hu uveno vachatano, manni? la rabbi yehuda vela rabbi yose.
Veella hachi kaamar: chorgo levaddo, aval giso – hu uveno vachatano. vaata rabbi yose lememar: giso levaddo, aval chorgo – hu uveno vachatano.
Veella, ha detane rabbi chiyyay: shemona avot, shehen esrim vearbaa, keman? la kerabbi yose vela kerabbi yehuda!
Ella hachi kaamar: chorgo levaddo, aval giso – hu uveno vachatano. vaata rabbi yose lememar: giso levaddo, vechol shekken chorgo. umatnitin – rabbi yehuda, barayyta – rabbi yose.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yose.
Hahi mattanta dahavo chatimi ala tere gise, sevar rav yosef leachshora, deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yose.
Amar leh abbaye: mimmay derabbi yose dematnitin, demachshar begiso? dilma rabbi yose devarayyta, defasel begiso?
La salka datach, deamar shemuel: kegon ana ufinchas dehavenan ache vegise, aval gise dealma shappir dame.
Vedilma, kegon ana ufinchas, mishshum giso kaamar?!
Amar leh: zil, kanya beede mesira, kerabbi elazar.
Vehaamar rabbi abba: mode rabbi elazar bimzuyyaf mittocho shehu pasul? amar leh: zil, la shavki li deotvinneh lach.

Rabbi yehuda omer kulei. amar rabbi tanchum amar rabbi tavla amar rabbi berona amar rav: halacha kerabbi yehuda. rava amar rav nachman: en halacha kerabbi yehuda. vechen amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: en halacha kerabbi yehuda.

Ikka dematne la leha derabba bar bar chana aha: et zo darash rabbi yose haggelili, "uvata el hakkohanim haleviyyim veel hashshofet asher yihye bayyamim hahem". vechi taale al datecha sheadam holech etzel shofet shello haya beyamav? ella ze shehaya karov venitrachek.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi yose haggelili.
Bene chamu demar ukeva

a: Kerovim venitrachaku havo. ato lekammeh ledina. amar lehu: pesilna lechu ledina.
Amaru leh: may dataych? kerabbi yehuda? anan mayytinan iggarta mimmareva deen halacha kerabbi yehuda.
Amar lehu: attu bekabba dekira iddevakna bechu? dela kaamena pesilna lechu ledina, ella mishshum dela tzayytitu dina.
Ohev ze shoshvino vechulei.
Vechamma? amar rabbi abba amar rabbi yirmeya amar rav: kol shivat yeme hammishte. verabbanan mishshemeh derava amri: afillu miyyom rishon veelach.
Hassone kol shello dibber kulei. tanu rabbanan: "vehu lo oyev lo" – yeidennu, "velo mevakkesh raato" – yedinennu.
Ashkechan sone, ohev menalan?
Kare beh hachi: vehu lo oyev lo velo ohev lo – yeidennu, velo mevakkesh raato velo tovato – yedinennu.
Midde "ohev" ketiv? ella sevara hu. oyev – may tama? mishshum dimrachaka dateh. ohev name – mekarva dateh.
Verabbanan, hay "lo oyev lo velo mevakkesh raato" may darshi beh?
Chad ledayyayn.
Iddach, kidtanya: amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda, "vehu lo oyev lo velo mevakkesh raato" – mikkan lishne talmide chachamim shessonin ze et ze, sheen yoshvin baddin keechad.
Mishna ketzad bodkim et haedim? hayu machnisin otan lacheder, umeayyeymin alehen, umotziin et kol haadam lachutz, umeshayyeyrin et haggadol shebbahen.

Veomrim lo: emor heach atta yodea shezze chayyayv laze? im amar: "hu amar li sheani chayyayv lo", "ish peloni amar li shehu chayyayv lo" – lo amar kelum, ad sheyyomar: "befanenu hoda lo shehu chayyayv lo matayim zuz".
Veachar kach machnisin et hashsheni, uvodkin oto. im nimtzeu divrehen mechuvvanin, nosin venotnin baddavar.

Shenayim omrim: zakkay, veechad omer: chayyayv – zakkay. shenayim omrim: chayyayv, veechad omer: zakkay – chayyayv. echad omer: chayyayv, veechad omer: zakkay, afillu shenayim mezakkin o shenayim mechayyeyvin veechad omer: eni yodea – yosifu haddayyaynin.
Gamru et haddavar, hayu machnisin otan. haggadol shebbaddayyaynin omer: ish peloni, atta zakkay. ish peloni, atta chayyayv.
Uminnayin lichsheyyetze, lo yomar: ani mezakke vachaverayy mechayyeyvim, aval ma eese shechaverayy rabbu alay? al ze neemar: "lo telech rachil beammecha", veomer: "holech rachil megalle sod".
Gemara hechi amrinan lehu? amar rav yehuda: hachi amrinan lehu, "nesiim veruach vegeshem ayin ish mithallel bemattat shaker".
Amar leh rava, yachli lememar: shav shene hava kafna, veabbava ummana la chalef.
Ella amar rava, amrinan lehu: "mefitz vecherev vechetz shanun ish one vereehu ed shaker".
Amar leh rav ashe, yachli lememar: shav shene hava motana, veinish bela sheneh la shechev.
Ella amar rav ashe: amar li natan bar mar zutera, amrinan lehu: sahade shakkare aograyyhu zili, dichtiv: "vehoshivu shenayim anashim bene veliyyaal negdo viiduhu lemor berachta elohim vamelech".
Im amar "hu amar li kulei". ad sheyyomru: "befanenu hoda lo shehu chayyayv lo matayim zuz".
Mesayyay leh lerav yehuda, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: tzarich sheyyomar "attem edayy".
Ittemar name: amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: "mane li beyadecha", amar lo: "hen". lemachar amar lo: "tenehu li", amar: "meshatte ani bach" – patur.
Tanya name hachi: "mane li beyadecha", amar lo "hen". lemachar amar lo "tenehu li", amar lo "meshatte ani bach" – patur.

Velo od, ella afillu hichmin lo edim achore gader, veamar lo: "mane li beyadecha", amar lo: "hen". "retzoncha shettode bifne peloni ufeloni?" amar lo: "mityayre ani shemma tichpeni ledin". lemachar amar lo: "tenehu li", amar lo: "meshatte ani bach" – patur.
Veen toanin lammesit.
Mesit? man dechar shemeh! chassore michassera vehachi katane: im lo taan, en toanin lo. uvedine nefashot, af al gav dela taan, toanin lo. veen toanin lammesit.
May shena mesit? amar rabbi chama bar chanina: mippirkeh derabbi chiyyay bar abba shemia li, shane mesit derachamana amar: "lo tachmol velo techasse alav".

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachman amar rabbi yonatan: minnayin sheen toanin lammesit? minnachash hakkadmoni. deamar rabbi simlay: harebe teanot haya lo lannachash liton, velo taan. umippene ma lo taan lo hakkadosh baruch hu? lefi shello taan hu.
May hava leh lememar? divre harav vedivre talmid – divre mi shomin? divre harav shomin.
Amar chizkiyya: minnayin shekkol hammosif gorea? shenneemar: "amar elohim lo tochlu mimmennu velo tiggeu bo".
Rav mesharsheya amar, mehacha: "ammatayim vachetzi orko".
Rav ashe amar: "ashte esre yeriot".
Amar abbaye: lo shanu ella deamar "meshatte ani bach", aval amar
b: "Lo hayu devarim meolam" – huchezak kafran.
Amar rav pappa bereh derav acha bar adda, hachi amrinan mishshemeh derava: kol mille dichdi la dechiri inashe.
Hahu deachmen leh edim lechavreh bechilleteh. amar leh: "mane li bidach". amar leh: "hen". amar: "ere veshachve lehevo alach sahade". amar leh: "la". amar rav kahana: ha amar leh "la".
Hahu deachmen edim bekivra lechavreh, amar leh: "mane li bidach". amar leh: "hen". chayye umite lehevo alach sahadi, amar leh: "la". amar rabbi shimon [ben lakish]: ha amar leh "la".

Amar ravina, veittema rav pappa: shema minna meha, ha deamar rav yehuda amar rav: tzarich sheyyomar "attem edayy", la shena ki amar love, vela shena ki amar malve veshatek love. tama deamar love "la", aval i shatek – hachi name.
Hahu dahava karu leh "kav rashu", amar: man massek bi ella peloni ufeloni? ato, tavuhv ledina kammeh derav nachman.
Amar rav nachman: adam asuy shello lehasebia et atzmo.
Hahu dahavo karu leh "achbera deshachev addinare". ki ka shachev, amar: "pelanya ufelanya masseku bi zuze". batar dishchev, ato tavinhu leyorshin.
Ato lekammeh derabbi yishmael berabbi yose. amar lehu: ki amrinan "adam asuy shello lehasebia et atzmo", hane mille mechayyim, aval leachar mita – la.

Perau palga, tavinhu ledina leiddach palga. ato lekammeh derabbi chiyyay. amar lehu: keshem sheadam asuy shello lehasebia et atzmo, kach adam asuy shello lehasebia et banav. amaru leh: nezil venayhdar? amar lehu: kevar hora zaken.
Hoda bifne shenayim, vekanu miyyado – kotvin, veim lav – en kotvin.
Bifne shelosha, velo kanu miyyado. rav amme amar: kotvin, verav assi amar: en kotvin. hava ovada, vechash la rav leha derav assi.
Amar rav adda bar ahava: ha odita, zimnin katvinan vezimnin la katvinan. kenifi veyatvi – la katvinan, kanfinhu ihu – katvinan.
Rava amar: afillu kanfinhu ihu – la katvinan, ad deamar lehu: "hevo alay dayyayne".
Mar bar rav ashe amar: afillu amar "hevo alay dayyayne", la katvinan ad dekavi ducheta, veshalchi, umazmeni leh leve dina.
Hoda bemittaltele, vekanu miyyado – kotvin, veim lav – en kotvin. bimkarkee, velo kanu miyyado, may? ammemar amar: en kotvin. mar zutera amar: kotvin. vehilcheta: kotvin.
Ravina ikkela ledimharya. amar leh rav dimi bar rav huna middimharya leravina: mittalteli veitanhu beenayyhu, may? amar leh: kimkarkee damu. rav ashe amar: kevan dimchasseri guveyayna, la.
Hahi odita dela hava ketiv ba "amar lana, ketuvu vachatumu vehavu leh", abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: hayeynu deresh lakish.
Deamar resh lakish: chazaka en haedim chotmin al hashshetar, ella im ken naasa gadol.
Matkef la rav pappe, veittema rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: mi ikka midde daanan la yadinan, vesafre deve dina yadi?
Sheelinhu lesafre deabbaye, veyadi. lesafre derava, veyadi.
Hahi odita dahava ketiv bay "ducheran pitgame",

a: Vechol lishshane deve dina, vela hava ketiv ba "bemotav telata havena vechad letohi".
Sevar ravina lememar: hayeynu deresh lakish. amar leh rav natan bar amme: hachi amrinan mishshemeh derava, kol ki hay gavvna chayyshinan levet din toin.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: i ketiv ba "be dina", tu la tzerich.
Vedilma bet din chatzuf hu? deamar shemuel: shenayim sheddanu, dinehen din, ella shennikreu bet din chatzuf. dichtiv bay: "be dina deravna ashe".
Vedilma rabbanan deve rav ashe kishmuel sevira lehu? dichtiv ba: "vaamarna leh lerabbana ashe", "vaamar lan rabbana ashe."
Tanu rabbanan, amar lahen echad: ani raiti avichem shehitmin maot beshidda, teva, umigdal, veamar "shel peloni hen", "shel maaser sheni hen" – babbayit lo amar kelum, bassade devarav kayyaymin.
Kelalo shel davar: kol shebbeyado littelan – devarav kayyaymin; en beyado littelan – lo amar kelum.
Hare sherau et avihen shehitmin maot beshidda teva umigdal, veamar: "shel peloni hen", "shel maaser sheni hen" – im kemoser, devarav kayyaymin; im kemaarim, lo amar kelum.

Hare shehaya mitztaer al maot shehinniach lo aviv, uva baal hachalom veamar lo: "kach vechach hen", "bemakom peloni hen", "shel maaser sheni hen". ze haya maase, veamru: divre chalomot lo maalin velo moridin.
Shenayim omrim zakkay kulei. michtav hechi katvi?
Rabbi yochanan amar: "zakkay". resh lakish amar: "peloni ufeloni mezakkin, ufeloni ufeloni mechayyeyvin". rabbi eliezer amar: "middivrehen nizdakka peloni".
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu leshallome ihu menata bahadayyhu, dilman deamar "zakkay" – meshallem, uleman deamar "peloni ufeloni mezakkin ufeloni ufeloni mechayyeyvin" – la meshallem.
Uleman deamar "zakkay", meshallem?! lema lehu: i ledidi tzayytitun, attun name la meshallemitun!
Ella, ikka benayyhu leshallome inhu menata dideh: leman deamar "zakkay" – meshallemi, leman deamar "peloni ufeloni mezakkin ufeloni ufeloni mechayyeyvin" – la meshallemi.
Uleman deamar zakkay, meshallemi? velemru leh: i lav at bahadan, la hava salek dina midde!
Ella, ikka benayyhu mishshum "lo telech rachil beammecha". rabbi yochanan amar: "zakkay" – mishshum "lo telech rachil".
Resh lakish amar: "peloni ufeloni mezakkin, ufeloni ufeloni mechayyeyvin" – mishshum demichaze keshikra.
Verabbi elazar it leh demar, veit leh demar. hilkach, katvi hachi: "middivrehem nizdakka peloni".
Gamru et haddavar, hayu machnisin kulei. leman? ilema levaale dinin – hatam kayymi! ella leedim.
Keman? dela kerabbi natan, detanya: leolam en edutan mitztarefet ad sheyyiru shenehen keechad. rabbi yehoshua ben karcha omer: afillu baze achar ze.
Veen edutan mitkayyemet bevet din ad sheyyaidu shenehen keechad. rabbi natan omer: shomin devarav shel ze hayyom, uchesheyyavo chavero lemachar shomin et devarav.

La, leolam levaale dinin. verabbi nechemya hi, detanya: rabbi nechemya omer, kach haya minhagan shel nekiyye haddaat shebbirushalayim: machnisin levaale dinin veshomin divrehen, umachnisin et haedim veshomin divrehem, umotziin otan lachutz venosin venotnin bedavar. gamru et haddavar, machnisin otan kulei.
Vehatanya: gamru et haddavar, machnisin et haedim! hahi dela kerabbi natan.
Gufa: leolam en edutan mitztarefet ad sheyyiru shenehem keechad. rabbi yehoshua ben karcha omer: afillu baze achar ze. bemay kamippalgi? ibbaet ema kera, veibbaet ema sevara.
Ibbaet ema sevara: ammane deka mashed hay, la ka mashed hay, umane deka mashed hay, la kamashed hay. veiddach: ammane bealma tarvayyhu kamashadi.
Veibbaet ema kera, dichtiv: "vehu ed o raa o yada".
Vetanya: mimmashma shenneemar: "lo yakum ed" – eni yodea shehu echad? ma talmud lomar "echad"?
Ze bana av: kol makom shenneemar: "ed" – hare kan shenayim, ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv "echad".
Veappekeh rachamana bilshon chad, lememar: ad dechazu tarvavyyhu kechad. veiddach, "vehu ed o raa o yada" – mikkol makom.

Veen edutan mitkayyemet bevet din ad sheyyaidu shenehen keechad. rabbi natan omer: shomin devarav shel ze hayyom, uchesheyyavo chavero lemachar shomin devarav. bemay kamippalgi? ibbaet ema sevara, ibbaet ema kera.
Ibbaet ema sevara: mar savar, ed echad ki ate – lishvua ate, lemamona la ate.
Veiddach: attu ki atu bahade hadade, bechad pumma ka mashadi? ella metzarfinan lehu. hacha name litzarfinhu.
Veibbaet ema kera: "im lo yaggid venasa avono",
b: Udechulle alma kerabbanan difligi aleh derabbi yehoshua ben korcha, vehacha beakkoshe haggada liriyya ka mippalgi. mar savar: makkeshinan haggada liriyya, umar savar: la makkeshinan.
Rabbi shimon ben elyakim hava mishtekid aleh derabbi yose berabbi chanina lemismecheh, vela ka mistayyay milleta. yoma chad hava yatev kammeh derabbi yochanan,
Amar lehu: mi ikka deyada halacha kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha, o la? amar leh rabbi shimon ben elyakim: den yada. amar leh: lema ezo. amar leh: lismecheh mar beresha. samcheh.
Amar leh: beni, emor li ketzad shamata? amar leh: kach shamati, shemmode rabbi yehoshua ben korcha lerabbi natan.
Amar: laze hutzerachti?! hasheta, uma ikkar reiyya bahade hadade amar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha "la baenan", haggada mibbaya?
Amar leh: hoil vealita, lo tered. amar rabbi zera: shema minna, gavra rabba, kevan deistemich – istemich.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar avin amar rav: halacha kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha, ben bekarkaot ben bemittaltelin.
Ulla amar: halacha kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha bekarkaot, aval lo bemittaltelin.
Amar leh abbaye: halacha, mikkelal difligi? vehaamar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav: modim chachamim lerabbi yehoshua ben korcha beedut karka!
Vetane rav idi bar avin binzikin deve karna: modin chachamim lerabbi yehoshua ben korcha beedut bechor, uveedut karka, uveedut chazaka, vechen shebbabben veshebbabbat.
Gavra aggavra ka ramet? mar savar peligi, umar savar la peligi.
May "vechen shebbabben veshebbabbat"? illema: echad omer achat begabbah, veechad omer achat bichresah? hay chatzi davar vachatzi edut hu!
Ella, echad omer: shetayim begabbah, veechad omer: shetayim bichresah.

Amar rav yosef: ana amena mishshemeh deulla: halacha kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha, ben bekarkaot ben bemittaltelin. verabbanan deatu mimmachoza amri: amar rabbi zera mishshemeh derav: bakkarkaot – in, aval la bemittaltelin.
Rav letameh, deamar rav: hodaa achar hodaa, hodaa achar halevaa – mitztarfi.
Halevaa achar halevaa, halevaa achar hodaa – la mitztarfi.

Ashkecheh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerav huna bereh derav yehoshua. amar leh: may shena halevaa achar halevaa dela? demane deka chaze hay, la ka chaze hay. hodaa achar hodaa name – ammane deka mode kamme hay, la mode kamme hay?
Deamar leh lehay batra: behay mane deodayy leh kammach, odayy leh name kamme peloni.
Akkatti, batra yada, kamma la yada.
Dahadar azel, amar leh lekamma: hay mane deodayy leh kammach, odayy leh name kamme peloni. amar leh: tanuach datecha shehitnachta et dati.
Amar leh: may nichuta? derava, veittema rav sheshet, sheda ba narga – lav hayeynu hodaa achar halevaa?
Amar leh: hayeynu dishmia li alayychu, derametu dikle vezakfitu lehu.
Nehardae amri: ben hodaa achar hodaa, ben hodaa achar halevaa, ben halevaa achar halevaa, ben halevaa achar hodaa – mitztarfot. keman? kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha.
Amar rav yehuda: edut hammachcheshet zo et zo bivdikot, keshera bedine mamonot.
Amar rava: mistabbera milleteh derav yehuda beechad omer "bearnaki shechora", veechad omer "bearnaki levana". aval echad omer "mane shachor", veechad omer "mane lavan" – en mitztarfin.

Vearnaki shechora bedine nefashot la? vehaamar rav chisda: echad omer "besayif harago" veechad omer "baariran harago" – en ze "nachon"; echad omer "kelav shechorim" veechad omer "kelav levanim" – hare ze "nachon".

a: Gavra aggavra ka ramet?
Nehardae amri: afillu echad omer "mane shachor", veechad omer "mane lavan" – mitztarfim.
Keman? kerabbi yehoshua ben korcha? emar deshamat leh lerabbi yehoshua ben korcha hecha dela machchashi ahadade, hecha demachchashi ahadade mi amar?

Ella hu deamar ki hay tanna, detanya: amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al shete kitte edim, sheachat omeret matayim veachat omeret mane, sheyyesh bichlal matayim mane.
Al ma nechleku? al kat achat, shebbet shammay omrim: nechleka edutan, uvet hillel omrim: yesh bichlal matayim mane.
Echad omer: "chavit shel yayin", veechad omer: "chavit shel shemen". hava ovada, veate lekammeh derabbi amme. chayyeyveh rabbi amme leshallome leh chavita dechamra miggo chavita demishcha.
Keman? kerabbi shimon ben elazar? emar deamar rabbi shimon ben elazar hecha deyesh bichlal matayim mane, ki hay gavvna mi amar?
La tzericha, lidme.
Echad omer: "bidyota haelyona", veechad omer: "bidyota hattachtona". amar rabbi chanina: maase ba lifne rabbi, vetzeraf edutan.

Uminnayin lichsheyyetze kulei. tanu rabbanan, minnayin lichsheyyetze lo yomar: hareni mezakke vachaveray mechayyeyvin, aval ma eese shechaveray rabbu alay? talmud lomar "lo telech rachil beammecha", veomer "holech rachil megalle sod".
Hahu talmida dinfak aleh kala degalli milleta deittemar be midresha batar esrin vetarten shenin, appekeh rav amme mibbe midresha. amar: "den gale razayya."
Mishna kol zeman shemmevi reaya – soter et haddin. amar lo: "kol reayot sheyyesh lecha have mikkan ad sheloshim yom". matza betoch sheloshim yom – soter, leachar sheloshim yom – eno soter.
Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: ma yaase ze shello matza betoch sheloshim, umatza leachar sheloshim?
Amar lo: "have edim", veamar: "en li edim". amar: "have reaya", veamar: "en li reaya". uleachar zeman hevi reaya umatza edim – hare ze eno kelum.
Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: ma yaase ze shello haya yodea sheyyesh lo edim, umatza edim? lo haya yodea sheyyesh lo reaya, umatza reaya?
Raa shemmitchayyev baddin, veamar: "karvu peloni ufeloni viiduni", o shehotzi reaya mittachat punedato – hare ze eno kelum.
Gemara amar rabba bar rav huna: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel. veamar rabba bar rav huna: en halacha kedivre chachamim.
Peshita! kevan deamar halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel, mimmela yadana deen halacha kachachamim.
Mahu detema: hane mille lechattechilla, aval diavad shappir dame, ka mashma lan, dei aved – mahderinan leh.

Amar lo: have edim kulei, amar rabban shimon ben gamliel kulei. amar rabba bar rav huna amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kedivre chachamim. veamar rabba bar rav huna amar rabbi yochanan: en halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel.
Peshita! kevan deamar halacha kedivre chachamim, mimmela yadana deen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel.
Ha ka mashma lan, divhahi en halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel; ha bechullehu – halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel.
Leappoke meha deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kol makom sheshshana rabban shimon ben gamliel bemishnatenu, halacha kemoto, chutz mearev vetzaydan ureaya acharona.
Hahu yanoka detavu ledina kammeh derav nachman. amaru leh: it lecha sahade? amar lehu: la. it lach reaya? amar lehu: la. chayyeyveh rav nachman.
Hava ka vache veazel. shamu hanach inashe, amaru leh: anan yadinan bemille daavuch. amar rav nachman: beha afillu rabbanan modu, deyanoka bemille daavu la yada.
Hahi itteta dinfak shetara mittute yeda, amara (leh): yadana behay shetara difria hava. hemna rav nachman.
Amar leh rava lerav nachman: keman? kerabbi, deamar otiyyot niknot bimsira.
Amar leh: shane hacha, dei baaya – kelateh.
Ikka deamri: la hemna rav nachman. amar leh rava lerav nachman: veha i baaya —
b: Kelateh!
Kevan deittachzak beve dina, "ibbaya kelateh" la amrinan.
Etiveh rava lerav nachman: simpon sheyyesh alav edim – yitkayyem bechotmav. en alav edim, veyatza mittachat yede shalish, o sheyyatza achar chittum shetarot – kasher. alma shalish meheman!
Teyuveta derav nachman, teyuveta.
Ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi yochanan: leolam mevi reaya vesoter, ad sheyyistattem taanotav veyomar: kirvu peloni ufeloni vehaiduni.
Ha gufa kashya: amrat "yistattem taanotav" – atan lerabbanan, vahadar amrat "kirvu ish peloni ufeloni vehaiduni" – atan lerabban shimon ben gamliel.

Vechi tema: kulla rabban shimon ben gamliel, ufaroshe ka mefaresh? may "ad sheyyistattem taanotav"? ad sheyyomar: kirvu peloni ufeloni vehaiduni. veha amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kol makom sheshshana rabban shimon ben gamliel bemishnatenu halacha kemoto, chutz mearev vetzaydan ureaya acharona?

Ella, ki ata rav shemuel bar yehuda, amar rabbi yochanan: leolam mevi reaya vesoter, ad sheyyistattem taanotav veyomru lo: "have edim", veomer: "en li edim". "have reaya", veomer: "en li reaya". aval bau edim mimmedinat hayyam, o shehayta disakkayya shel aviv mufekedet beyad acher – hare ze mevi reaya vesoter.
Ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi yochanan: hattokef et chavero baddin, echad omer "niddon kan", veechad omer "nelech limkom havvavad" – kofin oto veyelech limkom havvavad.
Amar lefanav rabbi elazar: rabbi, mi shennoshe bachavero mane, yotzi mane al mane? ella, kofin oto vedan beiro.

Ittemar name: amar rav safra amar rabbi yochanan: shenem shennitatztzemu baddin, echad omer: "niddon kan", veechad omer: "nelech limkom havvavad" – kofin oto vedan beiro. veim hutzerach davar lishol – kotvin vesholchin.
Veim amar: "kitvu utenu li meeze taam dantuni" – kotvin venotnin lo.
Vehayyevama, holechet achar hayyavam lehattirah.
Ad kamma? amar rabbi amme: afillu mitteverya letzippori.
Amar rav kahana: may kera? "vekaru lo zikne iro", velo zikne irah.

Amar ammemar: hilcheta, kofin oto veyelech limkom havvavad. amar leh rav ashe leammemar: veha amar rabbi elazar: kofin oto vedan beiro! hane mille hecha dekaamar leh love lemalve, aval malve – "eved love leish malve".
Shelachu leh lemar ukeva: lidziv leh kevar bitya, shelam. ukevan habbavli keval kodamana: yirmeya achi heevir alay et hadderech. imru lo: hassiuhu veyire panenu bitverya.
Ha gufa kashya: amrat "imru lo", alma dayyeynu attun. "hassiuhu veyire panenu bitverya", alma shadderu hacha.
(Ella), hachi kaamri: emaru leh, dayyeynu attun. i tzayet – tzayet, vei la – hassiuhu veyire panenu bitverya.
Rav ashe amar: dine kenasot hava, uvevavel la dayyni dine kenasot. veha dishlachu leh hachi – kede lachalok kavod lemar ukeva.
Hadaran alach ze borer.
